text: Están bien. Personalmente, he probado postres mucho mejores (brownies, macarons, pasteles y otros) en otras pastelerías, que tienen un sabor mucho mejor y, a veces, incluso son más baratos. Lo que están pagando es por la marca, no por la calidad del producto.
original: They are ok. Personally I have had much better desserts (brownies, macroons, turnovers, and others) from other bakeries that taste much better and sometimes are even cheaper. You are paying for the name, not quality of the product

text: Debo haber pedido el sabor menos popular: tarta de queso con arándanos. Era horrible. 3,75 dólares por esa comida congelada y rancia. Ojalá hubiéramos ido a Golden Spoon.
original: I must've ordered the most unpopular flavor: blueberry cheesecake. It was awful. $3.75 for that freezer-burned crap. I wish we would have gone to Golden Spoon.

text: I'm just here for the Brown Butter Almond Brittle, the best thing since sliced bread. After attending a Yelp event where my only regret was not choosing three servings of this ice cream. Needless to say that I found myself here again not long after. Don't be intimidated by the line outside of the door at Jeni's. It's only that way because there isn't much room inside for a line. They should consider getting those line makers that they have at the movie theatre so people aren't outside in the blistering heat. The lines move quick and the staff is very kind and diligent about moving customers down the counter, as there are three identical ice cream stations. I later went on a mission to find the ice cream in stores. Pints were $8 at Publix.

Small shop with a lot of variety. They have a lot you can park in and a couple of tables with benches outside. Inside is just the baked goods, no area for seating. Baked goods: ranged from cake slices, macarons, to pastries. We shared: - lobster tail: crunchier than I expected but I enjoyed it a lot. The cream filling is light, airy, and not overly sweet. Together, my husband described it like eating cereal. With the almost milky creaminess from the whipped cream and the crunchy pastry shell - New York crumb cake: was worried the crumbs would be the only good part but the cake is very moist and good! Overall a solid cake - horn (strawberries and cream): my least favorite, the pastry tasted undercooked. It was almost good. The filling seemed like it was just packaged strawberry cream cheese.

Not only does Mitchell's have the best ice cream around, this location is just the best. I love the open concept where you can see the factory setting behind the counter & two level seating for guests. There is a nice outdoor area to sit when the weather is nice that is a go-to in the summer time to hangout & enjoy your delicious ice cream. Favorite flavor: double chocolate chunk!!

Conveniently 24hrs, awesome macaroons (I didn't try them all), but definitely a bit pricey. I haven't tried my salted caramel brownie yet, but I hear great things. The croissant was nothing special, to be honest, I wonder if I could've asked for it to be warmed up, now that I'm thinking about it.
Este é um sorvete incrível! Ambiente muito peculiar, atendimento excelente e sabores maravilhosos! O sabor de nozes e manteiga é simplesmente perfeito, e o de morango é o melhor que já provei.
original: This is amazing ice cream! Very funky setting, great guys and wonderful flavors! The butter pecan is out of this world and the strawberry is the best I have ever had.

text: I had high hopes since many people would hype this place up but when I went I wasn't impressed. Personally what you get for the price point is not worth it in my opinion. We paid a little over $14 for the s'more sundae and strawberry shortcake sundae. First they didn't have the chocolate for the s'mores sundae so I had to substitute that. It came with one scoop of ice cream and a heaping of marshmallow fluff with one graham cracker broken in half. I did like that they toasted the fluff. Nothing wowed me from it. I've had better. Now for my husband's strawberry shortcake sundae. It was a flop. The "cake" was dry, hard, and almost old. It was as if they left it sitting out all day. You needed that ice cream to help get the cake down. The strawberries were hard and frozen and neither of us were a fan of that. We wish they would put fresh strawberries instead. They didn't put enough of the strawberry drizzle. What you see in the picture is all that was put on it. Again it was only one scoop of ice cream used. Honestly it's was an okay experience. The employees were friendly but were rushing us and the people before us. I will say if you want more for your money and better flavors, I recommend going elsewhere, like down the street to Nami!

Este lugar es encantador. Y sus donuts... ¡son increíbles! ¡Absolutamente increíbles! Vimos desde California y mi hija quería venir a probarlos. Mis hijos se despertaron temprano para ver qué pasaba. Y, ¡todo valió la pena!
original: This place is so cute. And their dounut are OMG!!! AMAZING!!! Came from California and my son girl wanted to come and check it out. My kids all woke up early just to see what the fuss was all about. And the fuss was all so worth it!!!

text: Eu não gosto de ser pessimista, e talvez eu tenha escolhido o sabor errado, mas fiquei decepcionado com o sorvete de massa de brownie! A placa na frente é confusa, diz "Ohio City Ice Cream Co." ou algo parecido, mas na verdade é da Mason's. O sorvete tinha um sabor muito fresco, mas não era muito saboroso. Os funcionários foram muito simpáticos e atenciosos, e o prédio é bem pequeno, mas é bastante charmoso, como se esperaria para a região. No entanto, acho que existem muitas outras sorveterias locais melhores (por exemplo, a Mitchell's?). Fico feliz por ter experimentado!
original: I hate to be a Debbie downer, and maybe I picked the wrong flavor, but I was not impressed by my brownie batter ice cream! The signage out front is confusing, it says Ohio City Ice Cream Co. Or something but it's Mason's. My ice cream tasted very fresh but wasn't very flavorful. The staff was very friendly and nice, and it's a teeny tiny little building but it's pretty hip, as you would except for the area. However, I think there are much better local ice cream establishments (Mitchell's for example?). I'm glad I gave it a try!

text: This place never disappoints me! They have the most wonderful croissants-so crusty on the surface and so soft in the inside. No master which flavor you pick, you never go wrong with it. The sweets are also very good. The shortbread cookies are sweet and special. I also like the dark chocolate cake with espresso syrup. It's super moisture inside, and the texture is so soft. Almost feels like drinking chocolate down your throat. Amazing! Really hope I can try everything they have, but seems like there are too many choices :)

Nossa, eu realmente pensava que só se comia sorvete com esse sabor em cima do céu. "Quem diria" que colocariam menta *real* no sorvete de chocolate com menta. Ben e Jerry... vocês foram substituídos por Jan e Helen! Dêm a eles mais alguns anos e esses ex-corretores de bolsa de Nova York estarão batendo a sino na WALL STREET quando a Sweet Republic for pública! Minha única reclamação é que eu gostaria que estivessem localizados na outra rua, para poder ir todos os dias pegar um sorvete!
original: OMG I really thought they only served ice cream that tastes this good in heaven. 'Who'd a thunk' of putting REAL mint in Mint Chocolate Chip Ice Cream. Ben and Jerry....you've been replaced by Jan and Helen! Give them a couple more years and these former New York Stock Brokers will be ringing the bell on WALL STREET when Sweet Republic goes public! My only complaint is that I just wish they were located across the street so I could walk for ice cream....every day!

text: Si busca productos horneados deliciosos, ¡no tiene que buscar más! Al entrar, puede tomar una bandeja y unas pinzas, y luego empezar a elegir. Ofrecen una variedad de panes, desde los dulces hasta los salados. Los precios varían entre $1 y $3 por unidad. Compramos una variedad de panes, como el de galletas de chocolate y el de mantequilla salada. Algunos de los panes tienen rellenos dulces, mientras que otros son simples panes salados y deliciosos. El lugar estaba muy lleno cuando llegamos, pero la fila se mueve muy rápido. Una vez que se ha avanzado un poco en la fila, hay alguien que le empaqueta los panes individualmente. También venden una variedad de cheesecakes, pasteles y bebidas. Cada paquete de pan tiene una etiqueta que indica qué es y si contiene huevos o leche. Compramos alrededor de 7 panes diferentes y un mini cheesecake soufflé, y el total fue de aproximadamente $20. Este lugar tiene una gran variedad de panes, dulces y bebidas. ¡Este lugar es imprescindible si visita Las Vegas!
original: If you looking to have some delicious baked goods than look no further ! When you walk in there is a place to grab a tray and tongs and then you go to work. They carry a variety of breads from sweet to savory. They range in price from $1-3 a piece. We got a variety of different breads such as chocolate cookie bread and salted butter bread. Some of the breads have sweet fillings and some are just savory delightful plain breads. This place was very packed when we came but, the line moves very fast. Once you get about half way through the line there is someone that will individually bag your breads for you. They also sell a variety of cheesecakes, cakes and drinks. Each case of bread has a label saying what it is and if it contains eggs or milk. We bought about 7 different breads and 1 mini souffle cheesecake and the total was about $20. This place has so many different varieties of breads,sweets and drinks. This place is a must try when in Las Vegas!!

text: Estaban abiertos solo para recoger los pedidos cuando fui durante la pandemia de COVID-19. Tuve la oportunidad de probar uno de sus postres estrella, el sundae de brownie de Cleveland. Era delicioso y muy refrescante. La porción es bastante generosa. El servicio fue bueno.
original: They are open for pickup only when I visited during COVID-19. I got to try one of their specialties, the Cleveland brownie sundae. It was nice and very refreshing. The portion is very generous. The service was good.

text: Ok, how adorable is this place? Parking is limited up front but there is a parking lot on the side with plenty of room. Walking in is like hopping back in time. It is a really cute little ice cream parlor. They have a bunch of fun nostalgic candy for sale too. My mom and I shared one of their seasonal freezes and it was so good. I am really glad we split it, they were nice enough to put it into two cups for us too. It was really good but also really sweet and I definitely would not have been able to finish one myself.

As sorveterias Upward continuam a surpreender! O sorvete é cremoso e saboroso, e eles oferecem principalmente sabores clássicos, com algumas opções exclusivas. O que diferencia esta sorveteria das outras é a variedade de maneiras de saborear o sorvete... tantas combinações para milkshakes, frappés, sorvetes e muito mais! Experimentei o float de torta de maçã com caramelo, com uma bola de baunilha e uma de abóbora... uma delícia perfeita para o outono! A equipe é simpática, prestativa e paciente. A loja também é incrivelmente limpa. Recomendo fortemente que você passe por aqui após o jantar, ou simplesmente durante a tarde!
original: Upward projects did it again!! The ice cream is creamy and rich, and they offer mostly classic flavors with a few unique options. What sets this ice cream shop apart from the others is all of the ways you can eat ice cream... so many combinations for floats, shakes, freezies and more! I had the Carmel apple pie float with a scoop of vanilla and a scoop of pumpkin ... absolutely fabulous fall treat! The staff are friendly, helpful and patien! The shop is also incredibly clean. Highly recommend you stop by after dinner or just because in the afternoon!

text: Fantastic pastries and drinks with a phenomenal atmosphere in a great artsy district of Charlotte. A bit pricey and not worth the hour long wait you may catch on a weekend evening. I do recommend the salted caramel brownie if it is your first time. Simply delicious
Un helado fantástico con una porción generosa. Probé el sabor de galletas de chocolate y planeo volver a comprarlo si alguna vez regreso a Cleveland.
original: Fantastic ice cream with a large portion. I tried the chocolate cookie flavor and plan on getting it again if I ever return to Cleveland.

text: Sou morador da região e já visitei este lugar algumas vezes desde que abriu. Nunca fiquei decepcionado com seus sorvetes. Adoro experimentar sabores e sobremesas criativas. No entanto, suas cupcakes, às vezes, não me agradaram tanto; às vezes, não são tão macias. É nesses momentos que eu prefiro ir ao Nothing Bundt Cakes (ou a uma padaria local). Dito isso, vou dar uma nova chance às suas cupcakes. O atendimento, no entanto, sempre é excelente. Na semana passada, quando fui experimentar a cupcake de gengibre, a atendente foi muito simpática. Gostaria de ter lembrado o nome dela (cabelo curto, óculos e uma voz doce).
original: I'm a local and have been here a few times ever since it opened. I have never been disappointed by their ice cream. I always dig creative flavors and sundaes. However, their cupcakes have let me down on occasion; they're sometimes not very moist. It's moments like that when I just want to stick with Nothing Bundt Cakes (or local bakery). That being said, I will give their cupcakes another chance. The service is always good though. Last week, when I went in to try the Gingerbread cupcake, the girl helping me was soo friendly. I wish I remembered her name (short hair with glasses and a sweet tone of voice).

text: O sorvete é um dos meus grupos de alimentos favoritos. Se você quer experimentar sabores de sorvete e sorbetes incríveis e diferentes, como taro, flan, halva, Brie e geleia... o Mason's é o lugar certo. Eles permitem que você experimente qualquer sabor, e com tantas opções interessantes, sinto que é uma ótima oportunidade para escolher o que realmente gosto. Eles acertam nos sabores! A equipe é simpática e atenciosa, o que é um grande diferencial. Como eu disse, eu adoro sorvete, e se você me desse um balde de sorvete de baunilha, eu ficaria muito feliz... mas os sorvetes do Mason's são sempre uma aventura de sabores. No entanto, o que mais me impressiona são os eventos e as ações sociais do Mason's. Eles têm noites de ramen, exibem filmes ao ar livre no verão e organizam eventos de arrecadação de fundos com sabores e comidas exclusivas (por favor, tragam de volta o taco de chocolate e o creme de amendoim!). Eu levei minha bicicleta para revisão lá em troca de uma doação para ajudar uma garota que sofreu um acidente grave de bicicleta. Tudo isso é mais impressionante do que qualquer coisa que eu possa comer. Eu adoro apoiar um negócio local, apoiar causas importantes, e se eu tiver que comer sorvete no processo... eu aproveitarei cada mordida!
original: Ice cream is one of my favorite food groups. If you want to try some crazy awesome flavors of ice cream and sorbets, like taro, flan, halva, Brie & jam... Mason's is the place to go. They let you sample any flavor and with all the interesting options, I feel like take advantage of this, you know, to make sure I make the right choice. They nail the flavors! The staff is friendly and down to earth which is a big bonus. As I said, I love ice cream, you could give me a bucket of value vanilla and I'm happy camper... but Mason's ice creams are always a flavor adventure. However, the most impressive thing is Mason's events and philanthropy. They have ramen nights, show outdoor movies in the summer, and host fundraising events with corresponding flavors and unique eats (please bring back the choco-taco and PB whipped cream!!) I got my bike tuned up there for a donation to help a girl who got in a serious bike accident. All that is more impressive than anything I can shove in my mouth. I love supporting a local business, supporting great causes, and if I HAVE to eat ice cream in the process... I'll enjoy every bite!

text: Desde fuera de la ciudad, vinimos a visitarlos basándonos en las excelentes recomendaciones de mis amigos de Yelp. Las reseñas son muy precisas. El local está en una esquina y, aunque la fachada parece un poco anticuada, no dejes que eso te disuada. Aceptan solo pagos en efectivo, así que asegúrate de estar preparado. Aproximadamente 11 dólares por docena, lo cual es una excelente oferta para donuts caseros y frescos. Compramos una docena de variedades diferentes. Los donuts con glaseado de chocolate estaban deliciosos, con un ligero toque crujiente en el exterior. Los donuts con glaseado de chocolate son súper sabrosos, y me encantó el grueso glaseado de chocolate y la maravillosa cobertura de crema batida. Los donuts de tocino y arce fueron una combinación perfecta de salado y dulce, con trozos de tocino fresco y glaseado de arce sobre un donut de levadura. Estos donuts de levadura no son los típicos donuts de levadura; están perfectamente glaseados y tienen una textura casi cremosa, así que caliéntalos en el microondas durante 10 segundos, y te lo agradecerás después. Los donuts de chocolate alemán son un pastel de chocolate glaseado con cobertura de nuez/coco y una maravillosa capa de crema de chocolate. Mi única preocupación es que no hay etiquetas en ninguno de los donuts, lo cual está bien para los residentes que visitan con frecuencia, pero dificulta la elección sin molestar al personal y a las personas que están detrás de ti. Sin embargo, esto no debería disuadirte en absoluto. ¡Los donuts son una visita obligada!
original: In the area from out of town and came in for a visit given the great advice of my fellow Yelp friends. The great reviews are so right. The location is on a corner and looks a bit dated on the outside - don't let this keep you away. They are cash only - so make sure you're prepared. Approx. $11 for a dozen which is a great deal for fresh homemade donuts. We got a dozen of assorted varieties. The glazed chocolate cake were great with a little crisp on the outside. The chocolate frosted cake donuts are super flavorful and love the thick chocolate coating and the wonderful piled high buttercream. The maple bacon was a wonderful mix of salty and sweet with fresh bacon bits and maple frosting on a yeast donut. The yeast donuts are not your ordinary yeast donuts - they are glazed perfect with almost a creamy mouth feel - stick in the microwave for 10 seconds - you will thank me later. German Chocolate donut is a glazed chocolate cake with pecan/coconut frosting and the wonderful piled high chocolate buttercream. My only concern is that there are no labels on any of the donuts which is fine for locals who may visit more often - but makes it difficult to decide without feeling really annoying to the staff and the line behind you. This shouldn't deter you at all though - The donuts are an absolute must try!

text: Eu tinha expectativas muito altas quando cheguei ao local. Experimentei o sorvete com sabor de Captain Crunch e comprei uma dúzia de cupcakes (cerca de $40). E, no final, fiquei um pouco decepcionado? Sim, tudo estava bom, mas não me proporcionou a experiência "incrível" que esperava em lugares como este. No geral, cupcakes úmidos e deliciosos, e sorvete gostoso? Uma combinação deliciosa, mas, na minha opinião, muito cara.
original: I had super high expectations when I came to place. I tried their Captain Crunch ice cream & I bought a dozen of cupcakes (~$40). And I was really... let down? Yes, everything was good but it didn't give me the WOW FACTOR that I was looking for in places like this. Overall, moist & yummy cupcakes plus yummy ice cream? Delicious combination, but way too overpriced in my opinion.

text: Based on the ham Gruyere croissant alone. Get there early. Been there 3x for it- 2x they ran out by early afternoon. Didn't try anything else.
I love sprinkles!! We love the cupcakes, ice cream and this time we tried the root beer float that was on point! Cupcake machine wasn't working though

Vi que tenían macarons franceses del tamaño de una mano, y supe que tenía que comprarlos antes de irme de Las Vegas. Nunca había visto macarons franceses tan grandes, y el precio no era nada descabellado, solo 3,50 dólares por unidad (en comparación con los pequeños y caros bocados habituales). No tenían tanta crema, y la capa exterior era un poco más dura de lo que estoy acostumbrado, pero seguían siendo ligeros y crujientes. Me gustaron por su tamaño y sabor, pero no tanto como otros que he probado.
original: I saw they had palm sized french macarons and I knew I had to buy a few before leaving Vegas. I've never seen french macarons so large and the price wasn't bad at all for $3.50 a macaron (compared to the normally tiny expensive bites). They didn't have as much cream filling and the outer shell was a bit harder then what I'm used to, but they were still light and chewy. I enjoyed them for their size and flavor, but I didn't enjoy them as much as others I've had.

text: ¿Qué pasa con todas esas galletas de macarrones? No me convencieron. Una galleta grande, rancia y demasiado cara. Lo positivo es que siempre me gusta tener una panadería en mi hotel cuando viajo, y esta en particular no tenía mucha gente esperando. El personal no era demasiado atento ni amable. Quizás notaron que no estaba sucumbiendo al "encanto" de las galletas de macarrones que intentaban imponer.
original: What is up with all the frigging Macaroons? Wasn't impressed. Big stale overpriced cookie. Plus side is I always like a bakery in my hotel when traveling and this one generally didn't have much of a line. The people behind the counter weren't too quick to offer service or too friendly. Maybe they sensed I wasn't succumbing to the Macaroon spell they were attempting to cast.

text: Este lugar é uma ótima sorveteria. Meu favorito é o "float" de birch beer. Delicioso e custa menos de US$ 2. Um "shake" de mirtilo foi feito com mirtilos verdadeiros. De verdade, nunca tive uma experiência ruim aqui. Só lembre-se de levar dinheiro, pois eles só aceitam esse meio de pagamento.
original: This place is a great Ice Cream Shop. My Favorite is the birch beer float. Delicious and under $2. A blueberry shake was made with real blueberries. Really, I haven't had a bad item here. Just make sure you bring cash, that's all they take.

text: Adoro esta sorveteria! Quando você entra, sempre é recebido com um sorriso. Eles têm uma variedade de doces que podem satisfazer qualquer desejo por algo doce. Os sorvetes são todos feitos em casa, e eles sempre têm alguns sabores novos e interessantes. Os funcionários são sempre pacientes quando se trata de experimentar todos os sorvetes antes de você finalmente decidir. Eles sempre têm um sorvete específico para maiores de 21 anos, o que te faz sentir especial. O espaço para sentar é limitado na parte de trás, mas é charmoso, com algumas bancas e mesas redondas. Em alguns dias, eles oferecem água saborizada gratuitamente, e eu sempre adoro isso.
original: I love love this ice cream shop. When you walk in you are always greeted with a smile. They have a variety of candies that could fulfill your sweet tooth craving. The ice creams are all homemade and they always have a couple of interesting new flavors. The workers are always patient when it comes to trying all the ice creams before you finally decide. They always have a ice cream that is only 21 and over which makes you feel special. The seating is limited towards the back but it's cute with a couple benches and round tables. On some days they do have flavored water for free, and Ive always loved that

text: Un lugar tranquilo y con deliciosos pasteles. Me encanta ir allí para charlar con amigos. :)
original: Chill spot and great pastries love to catch up with friends there! :)

text: ¡Qué rico! ¡Estaba delicioso! Recibí esta recomendación de un blog en Pinterest y valió la pena. Es una pequeña tienda con muchas opciones de helado y una gran variedad de dulces. Elaboran su propio "marshmallow creme", que es la razón principal por la que quería ir allí. Es mi helado favorito. Pedimos un "s'mores sundae" para compartir y era enorme y muy bueno. Le pusieron una generosa porción de "marshmallow creme" y lo tostaron. Normalmente me gusta más caliente y derretido, como un jarabe, pero este también estaba muy bien. El servicio fue excelente. Tienen un pequeño patio trasero donde nos sentamos y comimos nuestro helado. ¡Es un buen lugar si estás en la zona!
original: Yum! So good! I got this recommendation from a blog on pinterest and it was worth it! Its a small little shop with a lot of different ice cream options and a bunch of candy. They make their own marshmallow creme which is mostly why I wanted to go there. Its my favorite ice cream topping. We got the smores sundae to share and it was huge and really good. She put a big scoop of marshmallow creme on it and the torched it. I usually like it more hot and melted like a syrup but this was good too. The service was great. They have a little back patio we sat on and ate our ice cream. Good spot if you are in the area!

text: Entramos justo cuando estaban a punto de cerrar, solo quedaban un par de cannolis, así que los compramos junto con otras galletas, tarta de queso, brownies y café. Todo parecía delicioso. Elegí la tarta de queso, que, por cierto, es solo pastel, sin base. ¡Estaba increíble! Es un lugar pequeño y acogedor, y se nota que es uno de esos lugares que se llenan rápidamente y donde habría una cola larga, pero no en una noche fría y nevada. De nuevo, estaba cerca de cerrar, pero el personal no se mostró molesto; se acercaron y preguntaron si necesitábamos cajas o algo más, y fueron muy amables y también nos agradecieron al salir.
original: We walked in right around closing time, only a couple cannolis left, we bought them all along with other cookies, cheesecake, brownies and coffee. Everything looked extra yummy! I opted for the cheesecake which is all cake by the way, no crust. It was divine! Cute little place and you can tell it's one of those places that will get really busy and line would be out the door, but not on a snowy cold night. Again it was closing time but the staff wasn't annoyed, they came by and asked us if we needed any boxes or anything and were very welcoming and also thanked us while we were heading out too.

text: Great selection of yum yums but came here specifically for the French macarons... Which are HUGE, by the way, but pricey at $3 something per macaron. As a self proclaimed macaron connoisseur, I have to say that Bouchon macarons are nice because they don't use jelly fillings. I kind of hate jelly filled or jelly based fillings for macarons because they taste too sweet. Bouchon macarons are of a buttercream persuasion, but not too buttery like others I have tasted in the Bay Area. Perfect crunch, perfect chewiness, perfect light tasting filling.

Un lugar excelente para disfrutar de una gran variedad de helados caseros. Tiene un ambiente similar a una heladería tradicional, pero con un toque moderno y de Las Vegas. El personal es muy amable y servicial, y ayudan mucho a elegir entre tantas opciones. ¡Laura fue la mejor!
original: Great place to get a large array of homemade ice cream. Feels like an old style ice cream parlor with Vegas flare. Staff is so friendly and helpful with the many options. Laura was the best!

text: I had talked up the soft serve here because in my memory, the cereal milk soft serve was amazing. Alas, that was not the case when I brought a couple people here in December 2019. We tried all the soft serves they had, and they were all too sweet, and tbh, the cereal milk has a tinge of vomit taste; we didn't even finish the samples. The texture was also more custardy than traditional soft serves. I spent the rest of the trip trying to redeem my reputation surrounding food. In short, do not recommend the soft serve here. Nope.
Un pequeño paraíso en forma de donut. Ofrecen una gran variedad de sabores gourmet y productos únicos para cualquier momento en que desee un capricho dulce.
original: A little slice of heaven in the form of a donut! The have a very large selection of gourmet flavors and unique items for anytime you want a little something sweet.

text: Worth the hype worth the drive worth the wait... strawberry pop tart donut was as big as my hand definitely shareable. It's filled with strawberry and has the topping of a pop tart on top if your a fan of strawberry and donut plus pop tarts this was a great marriage. If you want a less massive donut and love apple or apple pie the apple crumb is the way to go the cake donut apple flavor again was great and my son even saved half for next day (still good) I also had a iced chai latte with almond milk and dash of cinnamon (didn't make the picture) perfect amount of chai to milk sometimes the spice from the chai can be over powering but this was great ( only regret was not getting a larger size) Customer service y'all know I love a good customer service.. they were friendly (the man plus women) sorry might even be the owner. But friendly, patient and did not rush me as I slowly looked. I was sad because the (FRENCH TOAST DONUT) served isn't during the week but if you go Saturday you can get it. Transportation I came from the strip and rode the deuce bus all the way to Fremont experience and just walked no more then 2 blocks they have a little back seating area then we walked back to Fremont st and saw the sights. When I'm back in Vegas this will be my stop!

Do NOT...I repeat, do NOT get the grapefruit tequila sorbet unless you really want to relive your college days of waking up with the taste of vomit in your mouth. Truthfully? The rest of the ice cream was so-so, but sadly underwhelming. Try the ice cream flight if you can't make up your mind - it's a good amount of ice cream for the price. The street was unlit and a little shady. Not a place to come if you're not familiar with the area.

Eu pedi o milkshake de leite com cereal para mim e um sorvete de chocolate com pretzel para outra pessoa. Não tive problemas com o sorvete, mas o milkshake de leite com cereal não estava muito bom. Tinha um gosto de leite velho e estragado, e não estava nem sequer completamente cheio no copo. Não valia o preço. Eu pedi o milkshake de leite com cereal no balcão, que deveria ter custado 7,5 dólares, mas eles cobraram 9 dólares por um sorvete de chocolate com cereal, e só percebi depois que o prepararam, relatei o problema e eles ficaram furiosos comigo por terem feito o pedido errado. Eles prepararam o drink correto para mim e, com raiva, ofereceram o drink errado de graça. Hesitei em aceitar, pois eles estavam irritados ao oferecer, e então, com mais raiva, disseram: "Ah, você não quer o de graça?". Antes que eu pudesse responder, eu peguei o drink e fui embora. Enquanto saía, eles me deram um tratamento e continuaram me olhando e minha família, e estavam comentando sobre mim e minha família. Foi extremamente rude, e o drink errado era simplesmente xarope de chocolate.
original: I got the Cereal Milk milkshake for myself and a chocolate pretzel soft for someone, no problems with the soft serve, but the cereal milk was not very good. Tasted like almost spoiled old milk and was not even filled in the cup, not worth the price. I asked for cereal milk at the register which should've been 7.5 but they charged me for a Chocolate cereal which was $9 and I didn't realize til after they made the wrong drink, told them, and they got mad at me for THEM taking the wrong order. They made the correct drink for me and angrily offered the wrong one for free, I hesitated on taking it because they were angry when offering and then they angrily lashed back "oh you don't want the free one" before I got a chance to answer, but I grabbed the drink and walked away. As I walked away they gave me attitude and continued looking at me and my family and were talking about me and my family. It was so rude and the wrong drink was straight up chocolate syrup.

text: O seu "Vanilla Swirl" nunca decepciona!!!! É sempre o meu principal objetivo ao visitar este lugar. Também experimentei o croissant, que é outra delícia. Voltarei a este lugar várias vezes para experimentar mais opções, e tenho certeza de que elas atenderão às minhas expectativas! O atendimento é excelente. Eles são atenciosos e nos dão tempo suficiente para explorar o local sem pressão.
original: Their Vanilla swirl can never go wrong!!!! It's always my ultimate goal for visiting this place. I also tried their croissant, which is another goodie. I'll make more trips to this place so I can try many more which I'm sure will never fail my expectations! The service is very good. They respond attentively and give us enough time to look around without giving any pressure.

text: Ok, então eu e minha melhor amiga decidimos comprar algo doce. Eu mesma não sou muito fã de bolos ou cupcakes, mas decidi perguntar o que ela recomendava, vamos experimentar. Entramos na loja e era agradável, limpa e convidativa. Embora tenha demorado um pouco para sermos atendidos, não foi um problema, pois estávamos distraídos com a delícia. Há uma grande variedade de cupcakes especiais e clássicos. No início, pensei: "Bem, vou pegar um de chocolate, já que adoro chocolate". Quando fomos até o balcão para pedir, a atendente pegou o pedido da minha amiga, o que me deu a última oportunidade de olhar o cardápio. Vou dizer que fiquei tão animada que gritei: "NÃO ACREDITO! ELES SERVIRAM APENAS O CREME!" Minha amiga riu, pois eu estava tão animada, e a atendente apenas sorriu, como se estivesse feliz. Desculpe ao casal que entrou na loja naquele exato momento! De qualquer forma, decidi perguntar à atendente para ter certeza de que o cardápio estava correto. Ela confirmou que servem apenas o creme. Com os olhos brilhando, pedi: "Por favor, dois de chocolate com granulado!". Por causa disso, este lugar se tornou meu lugar favorito para retornar. É bom saber que não fui julgada por não gostar de bolo. Em muitos lugares, as pessoas perguntam: "O que há de errado com você, não gostar de bolo?". Eu não recebi olhares estranhos ou comentários, o que me deixou muito feliz. Outra razão é que os pequenos potes de creme custam apenas 75 centavos cada. Então, é uma vitória para todos. Portanto, a única coisa que não posso avaliar é o sabor dos próprios cupcakes. Mas minha amiga disse que ela e seus colegas adoram. Então, se os moradores locais gostam, eu também gosto! Então, se você não gosta de bolo, definitivamente deve vir aqui!
original: Ok so me and the Bestie decided to get something sweet. I myself am not a fan of cake or cupcakes but decided what the heck she recommends it let's try it. We entered the shop and it was cool clean and inviting. Although it took a little bit to be helped it wasn't a big deal as we were side tracked by yumminess. There is a wide variety of specialty and classic cupcakes. At first I thought to myself well I'll get chocolate since I love me some chocolate. As we step to the counter to order the lady behind takes my friends order which gave me a last opportunity to look at the menu. I will tell you I became so excited that I yelled out "OMG THEY SERVE JUST FROSTING!!!!" My friend laughed because I was so excited and the lady just smiled like someone's happy. My apologies to the couple who walked in at that exact moment lol. Anywho I decided to ask the lady just to make sure the menu was right . She said yes we do serve just the frosting. With wide eyes I said please give me two chocolate with sprinkles!!! For this reason alone this place has become my number 1 spot to return to. It's nice to know that I wasn't judged because I don't like cake. Most places I go people say what's wrong with you that you don't like cake! I didn't get a snicker or weird look like I normally so so that right there made me beyond happy. The other reason is because the little cups of frosting are on lyrics 75 cents a piece. So it's a total win win. So the only thing I can't give a review on is how the actual cupcakes taste. But my friend did say that she and her co-workers love them. So if the locals love them so do I!! So if you don't like cake definitely go here!!

text: Sweet Republic é maravilhoso!! Esta foi a minha primeira visita a este local. Paramos para um lanche delicioso! Quando se está "adulto" o dia todo, é bom ter um lugar para "desligar" e reviver a infância com sorvete!! Eles têm opções deliciosas e várias maneiras de personalizá-las! Hoje, experimentei sorvete de caramelo salgado com uma tigela de waffle! Adicionei um marshmallow por cima!! Foi incrível!! O atendimento é rápido e atencioso!
original: Sweet republic is wonderful!! This was my first visit to this location. We stopped in for a tasty treat! When adulting all day it's nice to have a place to rewind the clock- and enjoy a flashback to childhood with ice cream!! They have delicious options and all kinds of ways of jazzing them up! Today I had salted caramel ice cream with a waffle bowl! I added a Marshmallow to the top!! It was fantastic!! The service is fast and friendly!

text: Got donuts there this morning. Place wasn't to busy. Got a dozen donuts and they are amazing. Taste great and service was good
The creamy coffee beans favor is unforgettable. Not too sweet and It went well with the peanut chocolate coated waffle bowl.
Really fun flavors and good quality ice cream! It's expensive but like, so are all ice cream shops. I would say it's worth it to indulge every once in awhile. The salted caramel flavor is a must!!!

Ordered a cookie cup with blueberry muffin ice cream, a fruity pebble macaroon and a toasted marshmallow on top! Was so freaking good, wish I took a photo of all the crazy delicious flavors they had to offer, wish I could've tried them all too highly recommend Fatty Daddys!!!

Soy adicto a las drogas y Amelies es mi proveedor. Mis favoritos son las tartas de frutas, los macarons de limón, y los macarons de agua de rosas (¡si tienes suerte de encontrarlos!). El "cream puff" de calabaza es delicioso, SI te gusta la calabaza. En cuanto a bebidas, mi favorita es el chocolate caliente, pero el té verde en polvo también es bastante bueno, SI disfrutas de un sabor fuerte con un toque de amargor. ¡Me encanta! También prueba el refresco de pomelo, solo pregunta, ¡todos los empleados son muy amables! Viernes y sábados, muy ajetreados, con una espera de quizás 20 a 25 minutos. Sí, espero... ¡Ve allí!
original: I am a drug addict and Amelies is my supplier. My favorites are the fruit tarts, lemon macaron oh and the rose water macaron if you are lucky enough to find them! The pumpkin cream puff is delish IF you love pumpkin. As far as drinks, hot chocolate is my thing but the green powder green tea is pretty good IF you enjoy a good strong kick with a little bitterness I looove it! Oh try the grapefruit soda drink just ask, all the employees are friendly with a capital F. Super busy Friday, Saturday nights with maybe 20 to 25 min wait line. Yes, I wait... Go there Meow!

text: Así que, Sweet Republic cumplió con las expectativas. De verdad, ¡estaba delicioso! Si te gusta el helado, tienes que probarlo. La tienda es pequeña, limpia, y el personal es amable. El helado de cereza con trozos de chocolate está lleno de trozos de cerezas deliciosas y maduras. El helado de vainilla es muy suave, cremoso, sencillo y maravilloso. El helado de chocolate belga es rico, perfecto para los amantes del chocolate. ¡El helado de Rocky Road es delicioso! Lo que realmente lo hace especial es el malvavisco casero: muy suave y esponjoso, con un sabor increíble. Ojalá hubiera comprado una bolsa cuando salíamos. Definitivamente lo haré la próxima vez. Yo pedí un cono y mi marido pidió un cuenco con waffle. Ojalá también hubiera pedido un cuenco con waffle. Es fresco y tiene un gran sabor con la textura perfecta. ¡Totalmente vale la pena las calorías! Estoy deseando volver y probar, digamos, todo.
original: So, Sweet Republic lived up to the hype. I mean seriously, so good. If you like ice cream, you have to try this. The shop is small, clean, and the staff is helpful. The cherry chocolate chip is full of chunks of delicious, ripe cherries. The vanilla is so smooth, creamy, simple, and wonderful. The Belgian chocolate is rich - perfect for chocolate lovers. The Rocky Road is so good! The homemade marshmallow is what really does it - so soft and fluffy, with such a great flavor. I wish I had purchased a bag on our way out. I will definitely do so in the future. I got a cup and my husband got a waffle bowl. I wish I had gotten a waffle bowl, too. It's fresh, and it has a great flavor with the perfect texture. Well worth the calories! I can't wait to go back and try, oh, say, everything.

text: ¿Alguna vez has ido a una tienda y has querido comprar absolutamente todo? ¿Alguna vez has estado a punto de perder un vuelo debido a las compras en una tienda? THIS.IS.THAT.STORE. Tuve esta experiencia en Los Ángeles y me sorprendió y emocionó saber que también tenían una en Las Vegas. Es una panadería asiática y parece que ofrecen pan recién horneado durante toda la noche. La cola era larga, pero valió la pena. Todas esas pastelerías, más un café con hielo y sal marina, costaron solo 21 dólares. En Chicago, habría costado más de 30 dólares. Me encanta todo aquí y desearía que hubiera una en Chicago. Perdón por todo, pero esto es mucho mejor.
original: Have you ever went to a store and want everything from the store? Have you ever almost miss a flight because of shopping at a store? THIS.IS.THAT.STORE I had this in LA and was pleasantly surprised/excited they opened one up in Vegas. This is an Asian bakery and it appears they have FRESHLY baked bread throughout the night. The line was hectic but it was well worth it. All of these pastries + a large sea salt ice coffee only costed $21..it would have been $30+ in Chicago I love everything here and wish there is one in Chicago. Sorry tous le jour, you ain't got nothing on this.

text: No me gusta mucho este lugar, el pan está demasiado seco para mí, y no pienso volver. Además, el servicio no es muy bueno.
original: I am not crazy about this one, all the bread is too dry for me, not going to go again! The service is not good!

text: This Banana Bread is like no other. The taste is unique. The size is perfect for a quick snack on the go. I really enjoyed every bite. I look forward to having another slice. The freshness makes the taste better.

El helado de Page es delicioso. Tienen muchas variedades diferentes para probar. La pareja que estaba delante de mí estaba pidiendo sándwiches de carne con queso. Yo probaré esto en una visita, y como postre pediré un helado.
original: Page's ice cream is so good! They have many different concoctions to try! The couple in front of me were ordering cheese steak hoagies. I'll try this on a visit with a sundae for dessert.

text: Eu sou apaixonado por donuts, e o Donut Bar só piora a situação. Na primeira vez que fui, eles tinham uma promoção de donuts com tema de aniversário. Eu pedi um desses e também um donut inspirado no Homer Simpson. A atendente colocou dois donuts com tema de aniversário na minha caixa, em vez de um, como uma surpresa especial, já que era a primeira semana de funcionamento, juntamente com o donut do Homer. Quando eu disse que também era meu aniversário e que isso era muito legal, ela colocou outro donut na caixa! Já voltei várias vezes, e ainda não consegui mais nenhum donut de graça; no entanto, quero dizer que também experimentei um atendimento tão atencioso! Recomendo experimentar o leite com chocolate ou o café, e não se esqueça de usar o banheiro, pelo menos dê uma olhada antes de sair. O restaurante em si é bem pequeno, então, por favor, explore a área do pátio para encontrar mais lugares para sentar, que são especialmente agradáveis nas manhãs de primavera e verão.
original: I am obsessed with donuts, and Donut Bar only makes this worse. The first time I went there, they had a special on birthday cake donuts. I told them I wanted one of those, and one of the Homer Simpson inspired donuts. The server placed two birthday cake donuts in my box, instead of one, as a special treat as it was opening week, along with the Homer donut. When I told her it was also my birthday and that it was really cool, she put another donut in there! I've been back several times, and still haven't gotten any other free donuts; however, let me just say, I've encountered the same friendly service! Consider trying the chocolate milk or coffee on tap, and be sure to use the restroom, well, at least look in the restroom before leaving. The restaurant itself is quite small, so please be sure to explore the courtyard area for more seating that is particularly nice on Spring and Summer mornings.

text: Presti's is a place that you have to go to if you're in Little Italy. There's a reason most people rave about it. I've been here around dinner time on weekends and most recently around lunch time during a week day. The good part about going during the week, especially before 3 or 4, is that you avoid the lines because yes, Presti is popular and there will be lines. There's a reason they tell you to grab a number. However, despite how daunting a line you may encounter - it never takes long to get through it and the end result is worth the weight. The staff if cheerful, helpful and quick without making you feel rushed and unwanted. The cannolis are great - the shell is crispy (the ones covered in chocolate are extra amazing) and the cream is perfect. I came with a friend and she raved about it between bites. Their vast assortment of cookies are amazing. Because of its size, Presti's can afford to have a lot of variety so there will literally be something for everyone. I'm partial to their Linzer cookies, both the apricot and the raspberry. They're especially good when paired with their coffee. This time around I got a mocha which was a bit too sweet for my taste but that may have been because I downed two co okies with it so take that as you will. Next time I think I'd follow my friend's lead and grab a latte - still delicious but not sweet. Apart from the baked goodies there's also several options for lunch or dinner including strambolies, pizza, pasta, etc.. I eyed the Spinach stramboli but decided against it this time around. The strambolies have the perfect ratio of filling-to-bread so it was hard to walk away. I will be back though and that stramboli will be mine. The interior of this place as a whole is unsuprisingly large. There are numerous tables where you can eat comfortably with a large group or just by yourself. I saw several people at individual tables sipping their coffees and working on their laptops. The entire front of the bakery is windows so the natural light is always there and always pleasant, especially on a good day. Or you could always grab a seat in their patio area out front. Not going to lie, sitting out there and watching the people walk by as I sipped my coffee and nibbled on my treat brought back the feeling of sitting at a cafe in Europe. It was bright and breezy and the people walking past spoke a mix of English and Italian. These same people, more often then not, popped inside to grab a coffee or pastry as well. When the locals stop by you know it's worth it.

Que decepção!! Não valeu a espera extremamente longa. Eles me venderam 3 bebidas, 2 caixas grandes e uma sacola. No entanto, depois de esperar em uma fila longa, precisei esperar novamente. O que não me incomodaria se tivesse recebido as 3 bebidas! Mas eles disseram que ficaram sem os ingredientes para preparar duas delas. Solicitei o reembolso por essas duas bebidas. Eles pegaram meu cartão e ainda estou aguardando o dinheiro. Isso não é como o da Califórnia. Que pena, eu gostaria que fosse!
original: So sad!! Not Worth the extremely long wait. They sold me 3 drinks 2 large boxes and one bag. However, after waiting in a long line I had to wait again. which I didn't mind if I would have received all 3 drinks! Nope they said the ran out of stuff to make it 2 of them. Asked for them to refund me for 2 drinks. They took my card and I'm still waiting for the money. This is not like the one in California. So sad I wish it was!

text: Pasteles y productos de panadería realmente deliciosos. El servicio fue rápido y el personal fue excelente. El lugar suele estar concurrido (está ubicado en el centro comercial Shanghai Plaza), así que fue genial que no tuvimos que esperar demasiado para llegar a la caja. Se puede sentar en una de las mesas disponibles y disfrutar de la comida. Buena calidad y muy sabroso! Además, obtuvimos un café gratis a través de su aplicación. ¡Estoy deseando volver :)
original: Really good cakes and pastries. The service was quick and the staff were on point! It gets busy there (located in Shanghai Plaza) so it was great that we didn't have to wait too long to get to the cashier. You can sit at one of the tables they have there and eat. Good quality and delicious! And we got a free coffee through their app! Can't wait to visit again :)

text: Había oído que tenían los mejores donuts de Cleveland. Estoy de acuerdo. Gran variedad. Estos no son los donuts típicos y tampoco son baratos, PERO valen cada centavo y cada caloría.
original: I had heard they had the best donuts in Cleveland. I agree. Huge selection. These are not your average donuts and they aren't cheap BUT they are worth every penny and calorie!!

text: Really disappointed. Waited for awhile, paid $9.00 for a piece of cake that was just OK. Nothing special about the taste at all!! It was pretty, I ordered the rainbow cake, but I've had better cake from the local grocery store. Probably will never go back.

I do not understand the negative reviews for this place! After watching the Netflix documentary I couldn't wait to try it during our stay in Vegas. We got the B-Day truffles, B-Day Latte, Cereal Milk Latte, Crack Pie, Bagel Bomb and Birthday Cake (don't judge, we were four people hungry for breakfast). The employees were so so nice and let us try all their soft serves (delicious). All our food was INCREDIBLE, I would definitely be back!!

It's not a sketchy dog groomer anymore with bars on the window. Get the cake!! It is an enormous piece for $6, moist, killer icing, not too sweet but such a treat yourself treat. I hope to try the extensive macaroons selection next and get a corner piece brownie - equal parts crispy and gooey. The one pass for me was the cookie bar, the cookies included weren't my favorite.

En primer lugar, esta heladería tiene un aspecto muy atractivo al acercarse, y el interior es limpio y agradable. Ahora, el helado aquí es excelente, y mi favorito, sin duda, fue el de nuez y mantequilla. La textura del helado era tan deliciosa que pedí una segunda porción. Además, ofrecen un excelente servicio al cliente, así que puedo afirmar que definitivamente volveré a Novel.
original: First off this ice cream shop just looks cool when you're walking up and the inside is nice and clean.. now the ice cream here is bomb and my favorite was by far the butter pecan! The dough melt was so bomb I had to order a second. They also have excellent customer service so it's safe to say I will most definitely be making my way back done to Novel!

text: Very cute little shop in a nondescript location. The inside is super cute, bright, colorful, and cheery. I love the fact that they sell a lot of their homemade candies, marshmallows, cookies etc. and they are all displayed and packaged very nicely. Now on to the ice cream! The selection of flavors is varied, but not overwhelmingly huge like a lot of places can be. They have sorbets on one side of the counter, and their ice creams on the other. I didn't try any of the sorbets, but they looked great. While the menu had a ton of great looking sundaes to choose from, I ended up creating my own. I got a scoop of the espresso, and salted butter caramel with salted caramel sauce, toffee butter crunch, whipped cream, and a toasted marshmallow to top it off! The blend of flavors all together was excellent. Individually the components of the sundae were even better. You can tell the ice cream is handmade, quality stuff. The espresso was smooth, and the salted butter caramel my favorite, though I didn't quite taste the "salted" part that much. The toffee butter crunch was definitely one of my favorite parts of the sundae, and I could have probably just eaten a bag of that. The salted caramel sauce complimented the ice cream and was super tasty. The grand finale of the toasted marshmallow made for a great presentation, though it was difficult to eat in conjunction with the ice cream, and I actually ended up taking it off and eating it separately. It could have been toasted more, but that would obviously have made the ice cream underneath it melt even more than it started to. I will definitely be coming back here and trying more things. I did also try a sample of the honey blue cheese, and it was tasty and unique, but not something I could eat a whole scoop of!
Siempre está lleno, pero nunca hay retrasos. La comida es excelente. Recomiendo la pizza, los cannolis de chocolate y la lasaña.
original: Always crowded but never slow, their food is A*. Recommend the pizza bread, chocolate cannoli, and lasagna.

text: Awesome ice cream. It doesn't taste too sweet like straight up sugar like some ice creams so you can tell it has great ingredients.
Wonderful eclairs and cream puffs, but the lobster tail pastry tasted off. Either burnt or stale or both. The filling was still delightful though.

Eu descobri este lugar na noite passada. Não acredito no que ouvi do dono. Os ótimos funcionários da SuperFarm SuperTruck fazem mais do que apenas o incrível sorvete Superfarm... não, não, não... eles fazem uma variedade enorme de sabores. Alguém sabe onde encontrar? SIM! Vamos detalhar e discutir a nova sorveteria, Melt. ~Os Pontos Positivos~ Bem, o dono é amigo do dono da Superfarm. Acabei de perceber que a Udder Delights também faz parte da rede de sorveterias... então, se você gosta da Udder Delights, vale a pena conhecer este lugar! Adoro a variedade de tudo. Um cara abre uma pequena sorveteria, praticamente ao lado do Lost Leaf, e, por acaso, ele tem sorvetes deliciosos e locais da Superfarm... INACREDITÁVEL!!! Eles têm uma variedade enorme de sabores. Atualmente, eles têm muitos sorvetes e sorvetes com sabor de frutas. Claro, eles têm os sabores tradicionais como chocolate, chocolate com hortelã, etc... mas, vamos, eles têm a Superfarm, que é um sorvete de avelã com chocolate e Nutella, delicioso! Só esse sorvete já é um motivo para vir aqui. Em vez de procurar a caminhonete da Superfarm ou ir para Gilbert, VENHA AQUI! O dono também é muito relaxado, é um pequeno negócio de verdade. Eles também fazem smoothies com os sorvetes frescos da fazenda. Basta vir e experimentar, você vai adorar. ~Os Pontos Negativos~ Realmente, não há muitos pontos negativos. Não está em um prédio muito bonito, está em uma casa reformada, do tipo que você encontra em Roosevelt Row. Não há mesas dentro, então pode ficar quente se você comer ao ar livre. É mais como "leve e vá", se você comer durante o dia. Eu vejo este lugar como um ótimo lugar para a noite, na minha opinião. Está em Roosevelt Row, e isso não é para todos os gostos. Se você gosta de adicionar coberturas e acompanhamentos, eles ainda não oferecem isso, então tenha isso em mente se for essencial. ~Os Segredos~ No geral, este é um lugar sólido, com 4 estrelas. O atendimento maravilhoso e acolhedor (do tipo bom), a variedade de sabores, a frescura dos ingredientes e o fato de que o sorvete é feito localmente, tudo isso contribui para 4 estrelas. É um lugar chique onde os "hipster" vão? Não. É uma loja que serve APENAS ingredientes locais e frescos, feitos na fazenda? SIM. Mesmo as lojas locais mais tradicionais não usam essas fontes tão frescas. A Melt também está aberta das 12 às 12, DURANTE TODO O DIA... Então, você pode aproveitar o sorvete quando quiser! A Melt recebe o selo de aprovação do Jefe! Venha e aproveite!
original: I stumbled upon this place last night. I can't believe what I heard from the owner. The outstanding folks from SuperFarm SuperTruck make more than just their amazing Superfarm ice cream...no no no...they make a whole slew of flavors. Guess who has them? YUP! Lets Melt down to the specifics and discuss the new gem ice cream shop, Melt. ~The Good~ Well, the owner is good buddies with the owner of Superfarm. I just realized Udder Delights is also under their tree of ice creameries...so if you like Udder Delights, check this place out! I just love the randomness of it all. A guy opens up a small, nondescript ice cream literally next to Lost Leaf, and he just so happens to have local, amazingly tasty ice cream from Superfarms...GO FIGURE!!! They have a ton of flavors, by the way. Right now they have a ton of sherbets and fruit-flavored ice creams. Of course they have the usual staples like chocolate, mint chocolate, and so on....but come on, they have Superfarm, which if you have yet to have it, is a hazelnut chocolate ice cream, with Nutella added. This ice cream alone is a reason to come here. Instead of tracking down Superfarm's truck or heading to Gilbert for your fix, COME HERE! The owner's also, are very relaxed, its a small business to the T. They also make smoothies out of the farm-fresh ice creams they have. Just come and try this joint, you will love it. ~The Bad~ There really isn't too much. It is not in the nicest building, its in a re-designed home, the kind your used to at Roosevelt row. They do not have seating inside, so it may get hot if eating out in the sun. Its more of a cash n' dash if eating during the day. I see this more of an optimal spot for later in the night, if you ask me. Its in Roosevelt Row, and that is not everyone's cup of tea. If you are the person that like add-ons and toppings, they do not offer that to this point, so keep that in mind if that is a must-have. ~The Down Low~ Overall, this is a solid 4 star spot. The amazingly kind and homely (the good kind) service, assortment of flavors, freshness of ingredients, and the fact that the ice cream is locally made all add up to 4 stars. Is it a swanky parlor where hipsters go to? No. Is it a shop that serves ONLY local and fresh farm-made ingredients? YES. Even most local in-house shoppes fail to use such fresh sources. Melt is also open from 12 to 12...ALL DAY..So you can get your Melt on whenever you want! Melt gets the Jefe Seal of Approval! Come and enjoy!!!

text: A hole in the wall location serving up unique flavors of ice cream and sorbets. I had the Morning Mess and had a Fruity Pebbles macaron on top of that. Awesome sauce.

Eu nunca tinha provado um cannoli autêntico antes, e foi delicioso! Meu grupo e eu jantamos na Trattoria e, depois, caminhamos pelas ruas de Little Italy em busca de algo doce. Os biscoitos italianos eram bons, nada muito especial, mas o gelato e os cannolis foram exatamente o que precisávamos! Já estava satisfeito depois do jantar na Trattoria, mas comprei um cannoli, comi duas vezes e levei de volta para o hotel, para depois da nossa ida ao bar à noite – perfeito! Eu recomendo muito este lugar para casais, pois o ambiente noturno era muito agradável. Pena que os adolescentes que trabalhavam lá não fossem um pouco mais simpáticos.
original: I've never had an authentic canoli before and it was yummy! My group and I had eaten at Trattoria for dinner and strolled down the streets of little Italy for something sweet. The Italian cookies were good, nothing too special, but the Gelato and the Canoli's were just what the doctor ordered! I was already stuffed from Trattoria, but I got a canoli, took 2 bites and brought it back to my hotel for after our nightly bar trip- perfect! I would highly recommend this place to daters out there as the late-night ambiance was quite beautiful, too bad the high school kids that worked there weren't a bit more friendly.

text: Tudo o que você colocar na boca aqui será delicioso. Eu venho aqui desde que ele abriu, há 5 anos, e sempre é perfeito. A única coisa que me impede de dar 5 estrelas é que agora está muito cheio de pessoas, e o ambiente que o Amélie's tinha não existe mais. Peça o petit gateau, o bolo pequeno de baunilha e morango!
original: Anything you put in your mouth here will be delicious. I've been coming here since it first opened 5 years ago and it is always perfection. The only thing keeping me from rating it 5 stars is that it is now so overrun with people that the ambiance that Amelie's once had no longer exists. Get the petit gateaux vanilla strawberry mini cake thing!

text: Everything is made fresh and you won't leave disappointed. There's also a dog bowl outside for pups on walks on hot days

Sorveteria excelente – definitivamente vale a pena experimentar se você estiver no centro de Madison. O interior é simples, mas eles oferecem uma grande variedade de sabores de sorvete – eu experimentei os sabores de chocolate e manteiga de amendoim em um copo, e foi delicioso enquanto durou :).
original: Superb ice cream parlor - definitely a must-try if you're in downtown Madison. The interior is ordinary, but they have a wide array of ice cream flavors - I had the chocolate and peanut butter flavors in a dish, and life was very good for the time they lasted :).

text: A gerente pegou nosso pedido e foi educada, mas não muito simpática ou falante. Os outros funcionários que nos entregaram as bebidas foram muito gentis e atenciosos, e conversaram conosco. Pedimos um mocha com um expresso extra e um mocha branco, além de uma garrafa de água. Tudo estava delicioso. Um dos pontos negativos foi quando pedimos a água, a gerente não nos entregou. Tivemos que voltar para pegar quando percebemos que não tínhamos. As bebidas, incluindo a água, estavam excessivamente caras. Uma loja como a Dutch ou a Starbucks teriam sido mais baratas e com o mesmo sabor. Também perguntamos se poderíamos comprar algumas morangos com chocolate e voltar para buscá-los antes do fechamento, para não precisar levá-los para todos os lugares naquele dia. Mas a gerente disse que não faria isso.
original: The manager took our order here and she was nice but also not super cheery or talkative. The other employees that gave our drinks to us were very nice and welcoming and talkative. We ordered one mocha with one extra expresso shot and a white mocha and a bottle of water. Every thing tasted great. Some of the negative things are when we ordered a water the manager didn't hand it to us we had to come back when we realized we didn't have it. The drinks including the water were super over priced. Dutch or Starbucks would have been cheaper and taste the same. We also asked if we could purchase some chocolate strawberries and come back and get them before closing so we wouldn't have to bring them every where that day. But the manager stated no she wouldn't do it.

text: Vine aquí para tomar algo dulce después de la cena una noche. Había escuchado mucho sobre este lugar, pero nunca tuve la oportunidad de visitarlo. Pedimos una porción de pastel de cumpleaños y un batido de chocolate de cumpleaños. ¡Todo estaba delicioso! Estoy deseando volver pronto y probar el resto del menú.
original: Came here for dessert after dinner one night. I've heard so much about this place but never had a chance to visit. We got a slice of birthday cake and a chocolate birthday milkshake. Everything was so good! Can't wait to come back soon and check out the rest of the menu.

text: Perdi a conta de quantas vezes já estive aqui. Nunca decepciona. Adoro o donut de pão français. Pena que este não tem cerveja, como os outros.
original: Lost count how many times we've been here. Never disappoint. French toast donut lifer. Too bad this one doesn't have beer like the other.

text: Fui a Churn por primera vez la semana pasada. Gestionaron todo con las medidas de distanciamiento social de manera excelente, y solo permitían que entrara una persona a la vez. El helado y las galletas caseras eran increíbles, y el servicio era excelente. Definitivamente volveré. La ubicación es fantástica, y está justo al lado de Windsor, junto con los otros restaurantes del proyecto Upward.
original: I went to Churn for the first time last week! They handled everything with social distancing very well and only had one party come in at a time. The homemade icecream and cookies were amazing and the service was great! Will definitely be coming back. The location is awesome and has Windsor right next door along with the other Upward Projects restaurants.

text: Adoro o sorvete e os biscoitos! Sempre peço o de aveia ou o de coco. Quase sempre há uma fila para o estacionamento, mas ela se move rapidamente. Vale a pena esperar.
original: Love their ice cream and cookies! I always get either the oatmeal or coconut macaroon. There is almost always a line out to the parking lot but it moves quickly. Worth the wait.

text: In A Nutshell: -If you are looking for nice sweet, cold sweet treat, then Sweet Republic has it covered. -Their sundaes are plentiful, but if you are there on a Friday, Saturday or Sunday, I suggest you order their "Toffee Banofi". -This sundae features 2 scoops of Madagascar vanilla ice cream, fresh bananas, almond toffee brittle & salted butter caramel sauce in a waffle bowl. -It's big enough to share for two. -Take it outside in the warm night air to enjoy. Overall, this is an award winning ice cream shop located in Scottsdale!

Pero, claro, digamos que le damos 3.5 estrellas porque es un concepto divertido. Nuestras amigas disfrutaron de un concierto en Planet Hollywood y caminaron hasta el Cosmo en una misión para encontrar el helado de cereales y la tarta de avena. La fila era increíble, incluso a las 10 de la noche. Pedimos exactamente lo que queríamos, más una galleta de avena para compartir. Para el helado de cereales, nunca he sido un gran fan de las galletas de maíz; pero entiendo el contraste y tal. Creo que la nostalgia vale la pena, y probablemente el precio se basa más en la estética. ¿Quién no ama los tiempos sencillos? En general, todo sabía a una cucharada de azúcar en cada bocado. No podía terminar ningún pedido por mi cuenta; mi tolerancia a la dulzura definitivamente disminuye con la edad.
original: But sure, let's just say 3.5 stars because it's a fun concept! Our girl gang enjoyed a concert at Planet Hollywood and walked to the Cosmo on a mission to find the cereal soft serve and crack pie. The line was insane, even at 10pm. We ordered exactly what we wanted plus one compost cookie to share. For the cereal soft serve, I've never been and still am not a huge fan of corn flakes; but I get the contrast and whatnot. I do think nostalgia is worth the hype and the pricing is probably more about aesthetics. Who doesn't love the good 'ol simple times? Overall, everything tasted like a straight up spoonful of sugar in every bite. I couldn't finish any single order by myself, my sweetness tolerance is definitely dwindling with age.

text: ¡La mejor boba en Arizona! ¡Es deliciosa y la tapioca siempre está fresca y masticable! Recomiendo el té de leche con azúcar moreno o el capuchino de matcha con fresas. ¡Ambos son deliciosos!
original: Best boba in AZ! So yummy and tapioca is always fresh and chewy! I recommend the brown sugar milk tea or the strawberry matcha latte! Both are so delicious!

text: Este lugar es un punto de referencia en la Universidad de Colorado. No es demasiado caro, ofrece una gran variedad de opciones y tiene un ambiente acogedor. Incluso si no eres de la zona, seguro que experimentarás sentimientos nostálgicos al visitarlo. ¡Excelente!
original: This place is a landmark in CU. Not too expensive, great variety, comforting ambiance. If you're not a local, you will still get those nostalgic feelings when you stop by here. A+

text: Um ótimo sobremesa, mas o atendente foi um pouco mal-educado. Parecia que ele corria o risco de ter problemas se mantivesse a janela aberta para conversar conosco.
original: Great dessert, but the guy working was a little rude. I felt like he was going to get in trouble if he kept the window open to talk to us.

text: La diferencia entre las opciones es impresionante. Campbell's es increíble. He probado las opciones en Lakewood, en el mercado del oeste, y todas me han gustado. Aún quiero probar otros sabores, ya he probado todos, pero definitivamente quiero llevarme una bolsa a casa. Soy un gran amante de la palomita de maíz.
original: The dichotomy is to die for!!! Campbell's is amazing! I've been to the Lakewood location, the westside market and I've been happy with them all. I still want to try more flavors, I've sampled them all but I definitely want a bag to go home! I'm an avid popcorn lover.

text: Wide selection of good looking cupcakes. My daughter always gets something chocolate and fun. My wife loves the Vegan Red Velvet. Yumminess in her mouth!! The staff is knowledgeable and very friendly. Love coming here!
¡DELICIOSO! El lugar de helados en Las Vegas. Me recuerda a la heladería local de mi pueblo. La degustación de cuatro sabores es lo mejor. También me encanta el "hurricane". La cola merece la pena.
original: YUM! THE ice cream spot in Vegas. Reminds me of the local ice cream shop in my home town. The four scoop sampler is where it's at. Also love the hurricanes. The line is worth the wait.

text: Fiquei na área trabalhando e consegui chegar logo após a abertura. A variedade de donuts é incrível! Eles criam algumas das combinações mais deliciosas que você possa imaginar, além de oferecer alguns clássicos simples. O lugar está cheio de energia e a equipe demonstra muito orgulho em seus produtos!
original: Was posted in the area for work and managed to make it in right after they opened. The selection of donuts is amazing! They dream up some of the most delicious combinations you can imagine as well as keeping a few simple classics on hand. The place is filled with energy and the staff really does show pride in their creations!

text: Pudim Clássico. Embora não seja a opção mais apetitosa, o sabor de limão é a especialidade deles, e tem a melhor textura de qualquer pudim que já experimentei.
original: Classic Custard. While not the most tempting sounding choice, Lemon is their signature flavor and it has the best texture of any custard I have ever tried.

text: O sorvete e as bebidas veganas são deliciosos e visualmente muito atraentes! O interior é charmoso e um ótimo lugar para relaxar.
original: Delicious vegan ice cream and drinks are so aesthetically pleasing! The interior is cute and great place to just hangout.

text: Experimentamos o milkshake com leite de cereal e a famosa torta "crack". Ambos estavam deliciosos e satisfazem o desejo por doces no final da noite. Sem dúvida, uma experiência interessante, especialmente se você não encontrar algo parecido em outro lugar, como em Las Vegas.
original: We had the cereal milk boozy shake and the famous crack pie. Both were good enough and hit the late night sweet tooth craving. Certainly a fun try for one of those things you might not have anywhere else but In Vegas.

text: Melt is a great place to go for decent ice cream and unique flavors! They got rid of their six flavor sampler, but you really can't go wrong here. Their horchata flavor was amazing and I haven't had a bad cereal flavor yet. With that said, the comments about there being pieces of ice crystals in the ice cream are accurate. Sure, it doesn't compromise the flavor, but it does show it's not the best made ice cream in town. Also, I don't really get the novelty of the ice cream coming in Chinese take-out boxes, but some people really get a kick out of it. Lastly, street parking can be rough to find some nights (but hey, it is downtown Phoenix so what do you expect). This place is definitely worth checking out because of the unique flavors and convenience, but Melt and Mary Coles are close to downtown too and they might be better!
Magníficas donas y un ambiente encantador. Servicio excelente y una gran variedad de opciones. ¡Definitivamente vale la pena visitarlo!
original: Great donuts and cute atmosphere. Frequently service and such a selection. Go check it out.

text: Mitchell's es el lugar ideal, tanto en invierno como en verano. Esta cadena de helados en Cleveland es realmente especial. Sus elaboraciones caseras están llenas de sabores que recordará durante mucho tiempo, incluso después de que se derritan en su boca. El precio es un poco elevado, pero no es excesivo, considerando que todos los ingredientes son frescos y provienen de proveedores locales. Apoye este lugar y disfrute de un delicioso helado :)
original: Mitchell's is the place to be whether it is the winter or summer! This ice cream chain in Cleveland is so special. It's homemade batches are filled with flavors you'll cherish long after they melt in your mouth. The cost is a little high, but not terrible considering all the ingredients are fresh and most local! Support this gem and enjoy some ice cream :)

text: Personalmente, después de cenar en Lola's, no tenía más espacio en mi estómago para postre, pero mi hermana insistió en que visitáramos este lugar. Parecía una fábrica. Pides tu helado en un lado del cristal y en el otro ves a los trabajadores preparando tu helado. No estaba seguro de si me gustaba la atmósfera del lugar, porque sentía que era muy industrial y un poco fría. El helado estaba bueno y las porciones eran generosas. Sin embargo, he probado helados mejores y no sentí que este fuera realmente el ideal. Probamos varios sabores y ninguno destacó particularmente. Prefiero Jeni's, y además, como no soy de Columbus, no puedo decir que sea un producto local. Pero supe que era una mala señal, ¡porque mi hermana, que ama el helado, ni siquiera terminó la suya! En cambio, la dejó en el reposabrazos junto a mi teléfono, esperando a que yo metiera los dedos en el helado. ¡Qué asco!
original: Personally after having Lola's for dinner I couldn't find more room in my stomach for dessert, but my sister insisted in checking this place out. It looked like a freaking factory. You order your ice cream on one side of the glass and the other side you see workers toiling away making your ice cream. I couldn't decide if I liked the feeling of this place because it felt very industrial and kinda cold. The ice cream was good and the portions were generous. However, I've had better ice cream and I didn't feel like this really hit the spot. We tried a good number of flavors and nothing really stood out. I vote Jeni's and because I'm not really from Columbus you can't say its Columbus pride. But I knew it was a bad sign because my sister, who loves loves loves ice cream, didn't even finish hers! Instead she left it in the cup holder next to my phone, waiting for me to dip my fingers in the slurry. Yuck.

text: Incrível. Histórico. Único. Acessível. Bem administrado. Uma joia em Pittsburgh!
original: Amazing. Historical. Unique. Affordable. Efficiently run. Pittsburgh gem!

text: A Presti's é uma padaria bem agradável, com diversas opções de refeições, além de produtos de confeitaria (sanduíches, saladas, pizzas, sopas) – eu particularmente gosto do ganache e de outros biscoitos para me manter feliz enquanto estudo. Os pequenos cheesecakes também são deliciosos, e há algumas opções disponíveis. Fica bastante movimentada nas noites de fim de semana, mas geralmente vale a pena esperar. Sinto que poderiam ter mais opções, mas estou bastante satisfeito com as escolhas disponíveis aqui.
original: Presti's is a pretty good bakery with many meal choices as well as baked goods (sandwiches, salads, pizzas, soup) - I especially like the ganache and other cookies to keep me happy while I study. The small cheesecakes are tasty as well, and there are a few options. It gets busy weekend evenings but is generally well worth the wait. I feel like there could be more options but I am fairly happy with the choices here.

text: Crack pie yesss! Blueberry pie cookie noooo! Well that's all I had but I would go back and get a whole pie!

Este lugar é ótimo. Meu lugar favorito em Charlotte. Há uma localização facilmente acessível na Pineville-Mathews Rd., perto de Pineville. É muito fácil de encontrar em um centro comercial agradável. É grande e muito bonito por dentro. Também oferece algumas bebidas alcoólicas. Há muita gente. Cappuccinos excelentes. Os doces são simplesmente incríveis. Este lugar tem uma atmosfera muito boa, ótimos clientes e um lugar incrível para relaxar.
original: This place is great. My favorite place in Charlotte. There is a location easily reachable in Pineville-Mathews Rd. near Pineville. It's really easy to find in a nice shopping center. It's big and really nice inside. Also has some alcoholic drinks. Big crowd. Great cappuccinos. Pastries are completely beyond belief. This place has such a good atmosphere, great clients, and an incredible place to hang out.

text: I have wanted to try Milk for along time. I was so excited to find out there was a location in Vegas. I have heard so many good things about the cereal flavored ice cream. I got the ice cream and a piece of vanilla confetti cake. The cake was awesome! The ice cream not so much! The ice cream was not very sweet and salty. I didn't like it at all! I feel it's very overrated. My biggest complaint is the price $6 for ice cream and $1.25 for some added cereal topping. The cake slice was $14. Now I know we are in Vegas and everything is over priced, but it really wasn't worth it. I ended up being disappointed .

O sorvete mais incrível de todos os tempos!!!! Cresci fora de Youngstown, Ohio, onde a empresa foi fundada. Mudar para Las Vegas me fez sentir falta do melhor que havia no leste. Mas, finalmente, a Handel's chegou! O sorvete é exatamente como o de Ohio. Tantas opções de sabores para experimentar, mas nunca consigo escolher meus favoritos! Experimente o sorvete de chocolate com caramelo salgado ou o trufado de caramelo salgado. Talvez você queira optar por um pote inteiro, porque é tão bom. A equipe é muito simpática e o proprietário é incrível! Continuem o ótimo trabalho, Handel's. Até breve!
original: The most amazing ice cream EVER!!!! I grew up outside of Youngstown, OH where the company originated from. Moving out to Las Vegas made me miss the best of the best from back east. But long behold, Handel's is finally here! The ice cream is dead on from Ohio. So many flavors to try but I can never get past by favorites! Try the malted chocolate peanut butter or the salted caramel truffle. You may want to pass up the scoop and opt for a quart because it is that good. Staff is super friendly and the owner is totally awesome! Keep up the great work Handel's. I'll see you real soon!

text: Os "sprinkles" (decorações) não causam nenhum problema no meu livro! O atendimento sempre é com um sorriso. Os preços são muito razoáveis, considerando as padarias gourmet. Os sabores de cupcakes sazonais são ótimos e frequentes, o que me faz voltar sempre. A cobertura em tudo é simplesmente divina. Em termos de estrutura, este local oferece todos os diferenciais especiais da Sprinkles, como a máquina de cupcakes e a sorveteria anexa.
original: Sprinkles can do no harm in my book! Service always comes with a smile. Prices are very reasonable in the scope of gourmet bakeries.
