La ubicación original en NoDa es la mejor, pero el estacionamiento y las colas pueden ser bastante complicados allí, independientemente de la hora o el día. Definitivamente, es un lugar que vale la pena visitar. Sus limonadas de lavanda y tartas de avellanas con chocolate son algunas de mis favoritas.
original: Amelie's is a unique place among all of the fast food and chain stores here in Charlotte. The original location in NoDa is the best, but the parking and the lines can be pretty rough there no matter the time or day. Definitely a must see. Their lavender lemonade and chocolate hazelnut tart are among my favorites.

text: Rude staff. Underwhelming beverages. I wanted this to be a regular spot for meetings, etc. but I was really disappointed.

Depois de ouvir tantas coisas sobre macarons, decidi experimentar os de Bouchon Bakery, já que estava hospedado no Venetian. Como nunca tinha provado macarons antes, não tinha com o que compará-los. Achei que eram deliciosos, e o de pistache foi o meu preferido. Não diria que me surpreenderam muito. Acho que preciso experimentar mais antes de dar uma avaliação completa. Esta padaria é um pouco escondida, então é possível que a perca.
original: After hearing so much about macarons, I figured since I was staying at the Venetian I must try Bouchon Bakery's macarons. Given, I've never had macarons before, I couldn't compare it to anything else. I thought they were pretty tasty, the pistachio was my favorite. I wouldn't say it knocked my socks off. I think I'm going to have get use to them before I gave a thoughtful review. This bakery is hidden so you might just miss it.

text: Donuts muito únicos. Saborosos e deliciosos. Nunca tive nenhum problema. Atendimento rápido e donuts deliciosos.
original: Very unique donuts. Very good and sweet. I've never had any problem. Fast service delicious dounuts.

text: Rewind has a trendy look, but the beauty isn't just skin deep. This is my go to boba place when I'm in Chandler. Layered drinks like the rose milk latte aren't just eye-catching on Instagram-- they're also delicious! I've tried their milk tea and their fruity tea, and they do both well. I would definitely bring anyone here, because they serve things like ice cream and can please people who don't like/aren't willing to try boba. It's also a little cheaper than some other boba places around here. Every time I've been here, the staff have been exceptionally nice. That, coupled with how quickly they make drinks, is what really makes them a five star establishment in my eyes. They also have a good variety of flavors, including non dairy and caffeine free choices, and the ability to customize sugar levels. Someday I'll get ice cream here, but their tea is so good that I haven't been able to not order it!

Deja lo que estás haciendo y ve a ver a Laura. Esta mujer es experta en helados. Volvería solo para escucharla compartir sus conocimientos sobre las combinaciones de sabores de helado. El helado casero es de primera calidad. Sabores únicos que satisfacen el paladar. ¡Laura necesita un aumento!
original: Stop what your doing and go see Laura! This lady knows here ice cream. I'd go back just to hear her drop knowledge on ice cream flavor combinations! The homemade ice cream is top notch. Eclectic flavors that speak to the flavor pallet. Laura needs a raise!!!

text: I love Amelie's, but it's frustrating to wait in line behind people who don't know what they want from the bakery case when I just want to order coffee. It would be lovely if they'd implement a drinks-only register for faster service. And PLEASE offer 2% milk like the Uptown location used to! Some tummies can't handle whole milk and almond milk isn't creamy enough. Otherwise, love it here.

Phenomenal. Came in early on a Sunday morning and was lucky enough to snag a French toast donut with the butter, jam and syrup sides. Got a birthday cake donut stuffed with an Oreo, the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut, the strawberries and cream donut, and a s'mores pop tart donut. The strawberries and cream donut was hands down my favorite, light, fresh and absolutely incredible- 10/10. They were all awesome- my only gripe was I wish the birthday cake donut had actual birthday cake filling in it besides and Oreo, that was the whole reason I got it lol. Nonetheless, love the vibe here and all of the amazing creations! Wish I would have gotten more than 5 but could not physically fit more in my stomach lol. Will be back!!! Atmosphere: 10/10 Value: 9/10 Flavors: 10/10 Service: 10/10

ECCENTRIC FRENCH There is a reason the line is out the door. This place is the place to be for great desserts, savory fillings and great beverages. The eccentric decor adds to the ambience and gives you things to look at while you are in line. The line is long, but goes quickly. Keep going in the back they have more seating than you think. My daughter enjoyed her eclair while I had the pot of chocolate. She had the turkey and bacon. I had roast beef and monchego. We brought home pastries for breakfast. Great value. Wonderful quality.

I love their macarons! I say the best ones I have had so far. I love love their chocolate and pistachio macarons. My eyes wanted more but I could only handle two. These are a pretty decent size macarons. The diameter is about two inches on these babies. The macarons are so fresh that your teeth sinks right in with a light thin crisp on the outside. The texture is soft and gooey like fresh baked brownies. Need I say more? Go and try it! I will come back for you.

Uma pequena e charmosa sorveteria no bairro, com alguns sabores deliciosos. O pessoal foi simpático, e adoro a ideia de servir sorvete em potes de take-away chineses, acompanhados de um biscoito de sorte. Definitivamente, um lugar para parar quando estiver no centro da cidade!
original: Neat little neighborhood ice cream shop with some tasty flavors available. Staff was friendly, and I love the quirkiness in serving ice cream in Chinese takeout containers with a fortune cookie. Definitely a place to stop when you're downtown!

text: I had the Seacliff it was really good just that I had to literally dig my way to get to the cookie in it.

Me decepcionó mucho no haber tenido la oportunidad de probar este lugar cuando estuve visitando Nueva York, ya que este lugar aparece en casi todos los artículos que incluyen frases como: "25 cosas que debes comer antes de morir en Nueva York". Por eso, me alegró mucho saber que se había abierto una sucursal en Las Vegas, un lugar donde visito con mucha más frecuencia que en Nueva York. Resulta que no estaba perdiendo nada. Probé el helado de leche de cereal con trozos de cereal, el pastel de "crack", la galleta de compost, la galleta de malvavisco con copos de maíz y la galleta de maíz. El helado de leche de cereal estaba bien; no era demasiado dulce, y realmente sabía a leche con cereal remojado. Pero no es algo que anhelara volver a probar. El pastel de "crack" – Lamentablemente, este pastel no cumplió con su nombre. Estaba seco por fuera, blando por dentro y terriblemente dulce. Imaginen cómo sabría una galleta hecha con mantequilla y una cantidad excesiva de azúcar... Sí. Todas las galletas – Extremadamente secas y demasiado dulces. Además, todos estos productos tienen un precio muy elevado. (El helado y el pastel de "crack" costaban $6 cada uno, y las galletas alrededor de $3 cada una). En general, el helado vale la pena probarlo una vez. No vale la pena comprar el pastel o las galletas.
original: I was really bummed that I didn't get a chance to check this place out when I was visiting NYC, as this place is mentioned in pretty much every article that goes something like, "25 things you must eat before you die in NYC." So I was thrilled to find out that a location opened in Vegas, a place where I visit much more frequently than NYC. Turns out that I wasn't missing out much. I tried the cereal milk soft serve w/ cereal crunch, crack pie, compost cookie, cornflake marshmallow cookie, and corn cookie. Cereal milk soft serve was nice; it wasn't too sweet, and it indeed tasted like milk where cereal had been soaked in. But it's not something that I would crave again. Crack pie - Sadly, this pie did not live up to its name at all. It was dry on the outside, mushy on the inside, and sickeningly sweet. Just imagine what baked butter with a crap ton of sugar would taste like... Yep. All the cookies - Super dry & way too sweet. Not to mention that all of these items are overpriced. (Soft serve & crack pie were both $6 , the cookies were something like $3 each) All in all, the soft serve is worth trying once. Don't bother getting the pie or the cookies.

text: Paré en su puesto en el West Side Market para comprar un cupcake, y luego vine aquí para conseguir palomitas de maíz y nueces de Brasil. El cupcake era increíble, de sabor a lima. Normalmente no soy muy fan de los cupcakes densos, pero este era suave y tenía un sabor delicioso. El glaseado era dulce, pero con un toque ácido. Las palomitas de maíz (probé las de frutas y me encantaron) estaban deliciosas. Las nueces de Brasil eran simplemente perfectas para mí. (¡Mi hermana las hace mejores!) En general, definitivamente vale la pena una visita. :)
original: I stopped by their stand in the West Side Market for a cupcake, and later came here to get popcorn and buckeyes. The cupcake was amazing--key lime. I'm not usually a fan of dense cupcakes, but this one was moist and tasted great. The frosting was sweet but a little tangy. The popcorn (I tried fruity and got dichotomy) was soooo good. The buckeyes were just so so in my book. (My sister makes better ones!) Overall, definitely worth a stop. :)

text: Ótimo lugar para tomar um café da manhã rápido ou um lanche. Gosto muito que esteja localizado em frente aos elevadores do hotel, para que não precise caminhar muito para conseguir um bom pão de queijo. Adoro o pão de queijo com presunto e queijo e também apreciam um bom café.
original: Great Place to get a quick breakfast, or snack. I really like that it is right across from the hotel elevators so you don't have to walk too far to get a good pastry. I really enjoy their Ham & Cheese criossant and they make a nice cup of coffe.

text: Great bakery with fresh authentic Chinese bread. And there are so many choices. But too bad it's in the worst plaza ever where there's never enough parking. Driving there and finding parking is a nightmare. This entire plaza needs a better parking solution.
Este es un lugar de donuts que siempre debo visitar cuando voy a mi ciudad natal, Cleveland. Sus donuts son siempre deliciosos y muy frescos. ¡Espero volver a visitarlos pronto!
original: This is a donut place I always have to have when I visit my home town of Cleveland. They are always so good and so fresh. Se you guys again soon!

text: My mother and I walked into sprinkles on a whim while just exploring near our hotel. I sampled the cookie dough ice cream and the captain crunch ice cream. Honestly some of the best ice creams I've ever had . The cookie dough ice cream had big big chunks of cookie dough all throughout the deliciously vanilla flavored ice cream. The captain crunch one tasted just like the cereal and not too sweet with bits of the cereal mixed in. Super smooth and creamy. The waffle cone actually tasted of vanilla and not just processed sugar. My mom got the milk chocolate cupcake . She said she was impressed by how moist it was beautiful texture of the cake and frosting, not too sweet , just the right amount of frosting . She only wishes she got a big "ole" glass of milk with it . And everything wasn't overpriced either ! Next time we are visiting Vegas we will surely be back! Now Candace needs to build a sprinkles in MN !!!

Todo lo que tienes que decir es "Helado de Babcock Hall". El mejor del estado. Esta tienda se encuentra en la Unión Memorial, además de en la ubicación cerca de los establos lácteos en Babcock Hall. Ir a Babcock Hall cuando era niño siempre era un placer para nuestra familia. Me alegra que ahora sea más fácil llegar desde la Unión Memorial. Todos los sabores son deliciosos.
original: All you have to say is "Babcock Hall Ice Cream" The best in the state. This shop is in the Memorial Union in addition to the location near the dairy barns in Babcock Hall. Going to Babcock Hall as a child was always a treat for our family. Glad it's now easier to get to in the Memorial Union. All the flavors are great tasting.

text: Dang it! I love Ice Cream!!!! I follow Melt on Insta and I love what they are doing. My buddy hit them up for lemongrass poppyseed and it was light and refreshing. I went with strawberry jalapeÃ±o and man was it not good. Lol. I love love love the exotic too. Just bad dumb luck I guess. I'll prob go with another off the wall flavor next time. This place has a great feel and good vibes. I'm hoping my next flavor is a knock out.

Thai Ice Cream is very fun and tasty, however, the downside is it does take about 5 minutes to make it. If the place is busy it may take longer. So make sure to pick the right time when there isn't a lot of people. Other than that, highly recommend to try their Thai ice cream and crepes!

Un lugar ideal para detenerse después de la cena, o en cualquier momento. Soy fanático de los eclairs de chocolate. No dejes que la cola te asuste, llegarás al mostrador en un abrir y cerrar de ojos. Decoración divertida, ¡tómate tu tiempo para explorar el lugar!
original: Great place to stop after dinner, or anytime for that matter. I'm a sucker for the chocolate eclairs. Don't let the line scare you, you'll make your way to the counter in no time. Fun decor, take a good look around.

text: Se você não gosta da Jeni's, então não podemos ser amigos. É o sorvete mais delicioso que você já provou, e eu não preciso mais ir até Atlanta ou pedir online. Tem fila, mas ela se move rapidamente, já que são pessoas que gostam de sorvete. Experimente a seleção – três sabores e um cone de waffle! Favoritos: Queijo de cabra e cerejas vermelhas, biscoito de amêndoas com manteiga, chocolate mais cremoso, e o cortado vegano!
original: If you don't like Jeni's we can't be friends. The best ice cream you'll ever have and I don't have to drive to Atlanta or order online anymore. There is a line but it moves fast as its just ice cream folks. Get the sampler - three scoops and a waffle cone chip! Favorites: Goat cheese and red cherries Brown butter almond brittle Milkiest chocolate The vegan cortado one!

text: Supporting a local business has never been more enjoyable! Neat place, friendly owners and staff, deliciously unique ice cream. They offer macarons that go really well with the ice cream concoctions too. FAVE -- Mangoneada with Chamoy. TIP -- They do run out of the macarons. Delivery is on Thursdays so stop by on a Thu or Fri to be certain that they have them for you.
Always a good place to stop by and grab some ice cream. I recommend the orange sherbert parfait.
Great place for crepes. It has been a staple of the Westside market for years!! Love going here!!

Este é um dos meus lugares favoritos para almoçar na região. Eles oferecem uma grande variedade de opções, incluindo sopas, saladas e massas. Seus strombolis e pizzas também são excelentes. Meu favorito é o tortellini de manjericão ou alcachofra, ou o parmesão de berinjela. Os produtos de panificação são excelentes, e é difícil escolher apenas um! Os doces especiais, como cheesecakes, podem ser um pouco caros. Estou feliz que eles trouxeram de volta os donuts, porque provavelmente são os melhores donuts que já comi. O gelato também é muito bom. Sou fã de um chamado Donatella. É como uma versão do chocolate Ferrero Rocher, com biscoitos de arroz, chocolate e avelãs. Delicioso! O Presti's é ótimo para trabalhar e observar as pessoas. Você pode tomar um ótimo café e usar o wi-fi gratuito. A única desvantagem é o movimento durante o almoço/jantar. Pelo menos, você pode pegar um número e ser atendido na ordem.
original: This is one of my favorite places for lunch in the area. They have tons of options, including soups, salads, and pasta. Their strombolis and pizza are also excellent. My favorite is the pesto or artichoke tortellini, or the eggplant parmesan. The baked goods are excellent, and it's hard to just get one! The specialty stuff like cheesecakes can be a little pricey though. I'm glad they brought back the doughnuts, because they're probably the best doughnuts I have ever had. The gelato is also very good. I'm a big fan of one called Donatella. It's like a remake of the Ferrero Rocher chocolates, with rice krispies, chocolate and hazelnuts. Absolutely delicious! Presti's is great for getting some work done and people watching as well. You can get great coffee, and use their free wifi. The only downfall is the rush during lunch/dinner. At least you can take a number and be served in order.

text: Whenever I'm in Vegas, I make it a point to have breakfast every day at Bouchon bakery. It's far superior to the Wynn cafe and unsurprisingly, cheaper too! Don't bother with the drip coffee or espresso drinks here; it's like drinking water. I'm also not a fan of their madeleines--they were flavorless and foamy. But everything else I've had? Phenomenal! Try the croissants (especially the STRAWBERRY ones), Parisian macarons (coffee, vanilla, and pistachio are my favs), their muffins, the red velvet cupcake, their focaccia, and the PB&J brioche. The eponymous bouchons are just okay, but are definitely satisfying if all you want is to fulfill a chocolate-y craving.

Staff was super friendly and amazing. The split strawberry was absolutely delicious and looks beautiful. Got a cappuccino that just topped off the whole experience. If you're in the downtown area I definitely recommend stopping by.

¡Una de mis tiendas de cupcakes favoritas! Me alegra mucho que hayan abierto una aquí. Pero ojalá no estuviera en la zona principal, porque es muy incómodo tener que conducir y buscar aparcamiento solo para comprar unos cupcakes. Espero que abran otra sucursal en el suroeste... ¡jeje (más cerca de casa)! He probado muchos sabores diferentes y el único que a mí y a mis hijos nos encanta es el de plátano. Todavía no he probado el helado, pero lo haré pronto. No compren los que vienen ya preparados para hornear, porque no son lo mismo y es un desperdicio de dinero. ¡El sabor no se parece en nada al de los que hacen en la tienda!
original: One of my fav. Cupcake shop!!! I'm so glad they open one here.. But wish it's not on the strip, so inconvenient to drive and park just to get some cupcakes. I hope they open another location on the southwest..hehe(closer to home). Tried a lot of different flavors and the only one I and my kids love most is the banana. I haven't try the ice cream yet, one of these day I'll. Don't buy the bring home and bake, it's not the same and a Waste of money!! Taste nothing like the ones they make in the store.

text: The macaroons are delicious, but I think that's all I will come here for in the future. Breakfast is overpriced and believe me, you're not getting anything special compared to the food court that is 10 feet away. It's worth a try but don't expect anything amazing.

24 de fevereiro de 2019, domingo - 21:30, para sobremesa. 5 adultos. Ambiente - 4 estrelas. Comida - 2 estrelas. Serviço - 4 estrelas. Local: Ao entrarmos no Cosmopolitan, vimos senhoras com sorvete. Elas nos disseram que tínhamos que pegar no segundo andar. Ambiente: Ao sair da escada rolante, podemos ver que é apenas uma janela para comprar. O lugar não é muito grande. Comida e bebida: Eu pedi o bolo de aniversário especial, que significa com álcool. Acho que a expectativa que eu tinha de tomar um milk-shake adulto havia desaparecido. Mas a expectativa acabou quando tentei usar um canudo largo e tive dificuldades para conseguir qualquer tipo de bebida. Precisei retirar o canudo várias vezes para comer o bolo de aniversário, que estava obstruindo o canudo. Outro problema foi com a vodka, ela não estava bem misturada no milk-shake. Algumas doses estavam boas, mas a próxima dose me surpreendeu, era como combustível de alta potência. Serviço: Minha esposa é celíaca, e eles nos alertaram de que a bebida que pedi não seria adequada para celíacos, devido ao bolo. Depois, comecei a pensar em qual tipo de vodka eles usavam. De acordo com a definição, a vodka deve ser feita de batata e ser livre de glúten, mas muitos destiladores usam trigo em sua vodka. Futuro: Não voltarei.
original: February 24, 2019 Sunday - 9:30 PM for dessert 5 Adults Atmosphere - 4 stars Food - 2 stars Service - 4 stars Background - As were walking into the Cosmopolitan we saw ladies with ice cream. They told us we had to get some on the second floor. Atmosphere - Come off the escalator and you can see that it is just a walk up window. There is not much to the place. Food Drink - I had the fancy birthday cake, fancy means boozy. I think the hype in my head to have an adult beverage milk shake was going off in my head. But the hype died when using an extra wide straw and having issues getting any shake. I had to pull my straw out multiple times to eat the birthday cake that was clogging the straw. The other issue was with the vodka, it was not mixed within the shake very well. Some sips was okay that was a good milkshake, next sip you go wow that was some high octane fuel. Service - My wife is gluten free and he warned us the drink I ordered for us would not be gluten free, because of the cake. Afterwards I thinking what kind of vodka they use. By definition vodka should be potato and gluten free but many distillers use wheat in their vodka. Future - I will pass.

text: Probé la pizza napolitana y los mini cannoli. Nunca había oído hablar de este lugar antes de venir, pero los productos horneados son bastante buenos. La pizza napolitana todavía tenía una corteza muy crujiente, y los cannoli estaban deliciosos.
original: Had the Neapolitan and the mini cannoli. I've never heard of this place prior to coming to his place but the baked goods are pretty good. Layers of the Neapolitan were still very crispy, and the cannoli were very tasty.

text: Hoy decidí que era el día perfecto para finalmente visitar Sweet Republic. Fui con mi padre y mi pareja, y el sabor estuvo a la altura de las expectativas. Pedí algo sencillo, el caramelo salado y cremoso, y lo acompañé con trozos de tocino (¡sí, trozos de tocino!). Era rico, con la cantidad justa de dulce y salado, y los trozos de tocino no eran demasiado duros al principio ni después de estar un poco sobre mi helado... Mi pareja pidió el Toffee Banofi y mi padre pidió el Campfire S'more. Personalmente, no soy muy fan de la banana, pero a mi pareja le encantó, ¡y a mi padre (el más grande amante del helado de mi vida) ¡lo adoró! ¡Yo también, de hecho... ¡¿Quién no se volvería loco después de probar un *malvavisco* casero?! Ok, así que sí, prepararon el helado rapidísimo (¡con intención!). Había suficiente espacio para sentarse y... ¡seguro nos volveremos a ver pronto! // ¡saludos!//
original: Decided today was the {D*A*Y} to finally visit Sweet Republic. Visited with my dad and hubs and the deliciousness lived up to the hype. I went simple and ordered the buttery salted caramel and topped it with bacon brittle {yes Bacon Brittle!}. It was rich with the right amount of sweet and salty and the brittle wasn't too hard to begin with or after it was on top of my ice team for a little bit ... The hubs ordered the Toffee Banofi and dad ordered the Campfire S'more. I'm personally not a banana lover but the hubs LOVED it and dad {the biggest ice cream lover in my life} went goo goo ga ga over the smore!!! I did too actually....I mean WHO WOULDNT GO NUTTY AFTER THEIR FIRST HOMEMADE *MARSHMALLOW*!?!?!?!? Ok so yeah, they whipped up the Sundays lickity split (pun intended). There was ample seating and well...I'm sure we will see you again soon!! //cheers//

text: Nossa! Decepcionado(a). Pedimos o bolo branco com cobertura de fudge, e não tinha nenhum sabor. A cobertura de chocolate não tinha gosto de chocolate de jeito nenhum. O cheiro da padaria era maravilhoso, mas acho que esse cheiro delicioso não era do bolo. Provavelmente, não voltaremos aqui.
original: Oh man! Disappointed. We ordered the white cake with fudge icing and it had no flavor. The chocolate icing didn't taste like chocolate at all. The outside of the bakery smelled so wonderful, but I don't think that wonderful smell was the cake. We wouldn't go back here again most likely.

text: Having been to the original NYC location I knew what to expect when I joined the late night crowd at Milk Bar. I've had the cereal milk soft serve, the pie formerly known as "crack pie", and some of their baked goods. Wanting to try something different, I got a chocolate birthday cake shake, which had pieces of chocolate cake in it and sprinkles. It was actually quite good, probably the best thing that I've tried at Milk Bar. It was rich and thick enough to satisfy a milkshake craving but thin enough to sip easily, sans the cake pieces that got stuck in the straw. When I finished the shake, I wanted more, which is always a good thing. But, after paying $7 for the baby shake, I'm just not sure that I could justify paying more for a larger one.

Eu simplesmente adoro o sorvete aqui. Sinceramente, não sou muito fã de cupcakes. Mas eles são fofos. A máquina que serve os cupcakes é uma criação incrível. O atendimento é satisfatório. EXPERTEM OS SANDWICHES DE SORVETE !! As porções são boas.
original: I just love the ice cream here. HONESTLY, not much of a fan of cupcakes. But they look cute. The machine that gives you cupcakes is an awesome creation. Service is satisfactory. TRY THE ICE CREAM SANDWICHES !! Portions are decent.

text: Apesar de amar donuts e sorvete, eu não conseguia imaginar como essa combinação poderia ser incrível. Sorvete dentro de um donut quente? UAU! Os sabores são deliciosos e o sorvete é denso e cremoso. O donut está perfeitamente polvilhado e tem a consistência ideal. A torta de creme de banana foi, sem dúvida, o melhor sorvete que já experimentei!
original: As much as I love donuts and I love ice cream, I couldn't imagine how mind blowing the combination could be. Ice cream inside a warm donut? WOW! The flavors are delicious and the ice cream is dense and creamy. The donut is glazed to perfection and the perfect consistency. The banana cream pie was hands down the best ice cream I've ever had!

text: En serio, el mejor batido de galletas y crema que he probado. Le quito una estrella porque el lugar definitivamente necesitaba una limpieza, y el suelo estaba muy pegajoso. Estoy seguro de que esto se debe a que se derramó helado durante el día, pero podría limpiarse una o dos veces al día.
original: Seriously the best cookies n cream milkshake I've ever had. Removing one star because the place definitely needed cleaned up and the floor was super sticky. I'm sure this is from ice cream spilled throughout the day but it could stand to be cleaned up once or twice a day.

text: Sinceramente, quase não vim aqui por causa das avaliações negativas. Mas, sabe, estou feliz que decidimos experimentar. O bolo e os cannolis estavam ótimos! O bolo não estava seco, como alguns disseram. Estava úmido e muito saboroso. Se estiverem no Venetian, vale a pena experimentar a Carlo's Bakery!
original: I honestly almost didn't go here because of the negative reviews. But you know what... I'm glad we decided to see for ourselves. The cake and cannoli were great! The cake wasn't dry as others have said. It was moist and very good. Give Carlo's Bakery a shot if you're at the Venetian!

text: Mi esposa y yo fuimos aquí para una cena especial después del Día de San Valentín. El helado de chocolate alemán estaba delicioso. Disfruté cada cucharada. Volvería sin dudarlo. Mi esposa pidió el helado de whisky, que también estaba muy bueno.
original: My wife and I went here for an after valentine's day dinner treat. The german chocolate ice cream was divine. I savored every bite. I would return in a heartbeat. My wife ordered the alcoholic Whiskey flavored ice cream that was also quite good.

text: A must-visit when in Charlotte. It's a cute place that is way larger than you would think with quirky eclectic (and a little bit sarcastic) decor that gives the place a cozy feel. It's a little bit on the pricey side in my opinion so be prepared for that however I ordered a meal and 2 desserts: turkey bacon sandwich paired with spinach asparagus leek, a Napoleon and a hazelnut treat. All very good. It was all kind of messy but worth it. My only complaints are dirty tables and the Napoleon which was very good however it didn't cut/break easily and the creme just kinda squished out when pressure applied. I fully intend on returning and trying out more!

Fui el otro día sin mucho plan y quedé muy contento con la gran variedad de productos y la amabilidad del personal. La tienda de chocolate no solo ofrece caramelos de leche, chocolate negro y blanco, sino que también tiene una excelente selección de "cake pops". Probé el especial que tenían para el Día de San Patricio y ¡fue increíble! Estoy deseando volver pronto para probar aún más de sus deliciosos caramelos.
original: I stopped in the other day on a whim and was very pleasantly surprised with the large selection of items and the friendliness of those running the business. The chocolate shop not only carries milk, dark, and white chocolate candies, but has an awesome selection of cake pops. I tried the special one they had made for St. Patty's Day and it was phenomenal! I can't wait for my next trip back to try even more of their great candies!

text: Fecha de la visita: 4/11/22. Después de conseguir un trozo de pastel de arcoíris de una de las máquinas expendedoras ubicadas en toda la Strip (de verdad, son casi tan comunes como Starbucks aquí!), mi pareja y yo decidimos comprar directamente en Carlo's Bake Shop, ubicado en el Palazzo. Es probable que haya que esperar para hacer el pedido, ya que este lugar suele estar muy concurrido. Aunque debo decir que no me gusta la disposición de la cola; es difícil ver qué se quiere pedir sin parecer que se está retrasando a los demás. Desearía que hubiera una forma de ver mejor qué tienen disponibles antes de hacer el pedido, creo que eso mejoraría el flujo de personas. El personal fue amable y el pastel estaba increíble; incluso se mantuvo fresco durante más de un día, ya que comimos un poco en la habitación del hotel sin llenarnos demasiado. Sin duda, volvería y probar otros productos la próxima vez que estemos aquí, o incluso simplemente pedir otro trozo de este pastel.
original: Date of visit: 4/11/22 Having snagged a piece of rainbow cake from one of the ubiquitous vending machines found on the Strip (seriously, they are almost as plentiful as Starbucks here!), my love and I decided to grab a piece from the source, Carlo's Bake Shop located in the Palazzo. Expect a wait to place your order, this place is pretty much always busy. I will say that I don't love the setup for the line, it's hard to see what you want to order without feeling like you're holding up the line for everyone else. I do wish there was a way to better scope out what they have before it's time to order, I feel that would improve the flow of traffic as well. Staff was friendly and the cake was fantastic, it even kept for over a day as we had bites here and there in the hotel room as to not gorge ourselves completely! I would certainly come back and try some other things the next time we are here, or even just get another slice of this cake!

text: I love this place... it's my hidden gem! I like going here because it's in the cut( not busy) and I like their different flavors and pairings they make. Plus I like the concept of using a fried rice box to put the ice cream in and putting a fortune cookie on top.... PURE GENIUS!!! I like that they ask you if you would like to sample options and the workers are always friendly and kind! Only knock I have which isn't a big one, but still a knock lol is that I usually go late at night(open until 12am) and they either ran out of ice cream options or don't have what I would like! Other than that it's a cool spot to take family, friends, and a date to. I have tried a few different types of their ice creams.. "Reese Puffs".. "Fruity Pebbles".. "Cake Batter"... "Butterfinger".. BOMB.. SUPER BOMB!! So if you have a chance check it out!

Um amigo nosso nos recomendou os "cream puffs" deste lugar, e quando precisei de algo doce, decidi seguir a sugestão. Fiquei muito feliz com a escolha! Eles tinham uma grande variedade de tudo. Além dos "cream puffs", também pedimos uma seleção de biscoitos e brownies. Tudo acabou naquela noite. Adoro este lugar!
original: A friend of our a suggested the cream puffs from this place and when I needed a sweet tooth fix I took the suggestion. I am happy I did! They had a huge variety of everything available. In addition to the puffs we got an assortment of cookies and brownies. Everything was gone that night. Love this little spot!

text: Estava muito animado para visitar o Sinful Sweets, e até mesmo economizei calorias por algumas semanas. Tinha ouvido falar sobre o bacon coberto de chocolate e parece ser uma combinação realmente criativa! No entanto, não correspondeu às minhas expectativas. Primeiro, o bacon não estava bem cozido, quase cru, e a parte gordurosa ainda estava branca. Mesmo coberto de chocolate, estava horrível e eu cuspi. Um dia triste. Quanto aos outros doces, experimentei um "turtle" de nozes pecan e um trufado com chocolate e frutas cobertas. Estavam bons, mas difíceis de apreciar depois do bacon. Na minha última visita, optei por sorvete, e o bolo de cenoura estava muito bom. O atendimento é excelente, muito atencioso. Talvez eu volte a experimentar, depois de superar essa experiência desagradável com o bacon.
original: I was so excited to visit Sinful Sweets, I actually saved up calories for a couple weeks. I had heard about their chocolate covered bacon and it sounds like a real genius combination! However, it did to live up to my expectations. First off, the bacon was not properly cooked, almost raw and the fatty part was still white. Even dipped in chocolate, it was gross and I spit it out. Sad day. For my other treats, I got some of a pecan turtle and a truffle and chocolate covered fruit. They were good, but hard to enjoy after the bacon. On I previous visit, I opted for ice cream, the carrot cake was very good. Service is great, very friendly. I might give them another try, after I get over that nasty bacon.

text: Churn ofrece helados de sabor exquisito, aunque de estilo "normcore", servidos por dos de los heladeros más amables y entretenidos que he conocido. En resumen, dos chicos entusiastas saludaron a mi madre y a mí diciendo: "¡Nos encanta ofrecer muestras!". Tardé apenas catorce segundos en decidir que quería que estos fueran las únicas dos personas con las que interactuar cada día. Así que, mientras pruebo todo y trato de no pronunciar las palabras "te quiero", el heladero número 2 me dice que el café vietnamita es la opción perfecta para las galletas de menta. Para mi sorpresa, le informo que consumir cafe a esta hora es peligroso. Él me dice que es descafeinado. Hago un pequeño sonido de animal. Las galletas de menta y el café vietnamita, perfectamente combinadas, en un cono de waffle (ligeramente rancio), con una porción de un delicioso, inusualmente ligero, chocolate caliente casero, estaban realmente buenas. Sin embargo, considerando el servicio increíblemente encantador, la experiencia pasa de "muy buena" a "increíble", convirtiendo a Churn en uno de mis lugares favoritos para comer helado en Phoenix.
original: Churn offers tasteful, albeit, normcore ice creams served by two of the friendliest, most engaging ice cream scooper deities I have ever encountered. In a nutshell, two enthusiastic dudes greeted my mom and I with, "we love giving out samples!" and it took me fourteen seconds to decide that I want these to be the only two people I have to interact with on any given day. So while I'm sampling everything and carefully trying not to mouth the words "I love you," fantastic ice cream scooper #2 tells me that Vietnamese coffee is the obvious pairing choice for mint cookie. To my dismay, I inform him that caffeine at this moderately late hour is dangerous. He tells me it's decaffeinated. I make a small animal noise. The perfectly paired mint cookie and Vietnamese coffee in a (slightly stale) waffle cone with a side of homemade, excellent, unusually light hot fudge was real good. However, by factoring in impossibly charismatic service, the experience goes from real good to dopesauce, making Churn one of my favorite ice cream spots in Phoenix.

text: Comecei a frequentar este lugar há cerca de 6 meses, e, sério, não consigo acreditar que não tinha vindo antes! Estou apaixonado pelo sorvete que eles fazem aqui. Os funcionários são sempre simpáticos. Também é recomendado dar gorjetas aos funcionários, então, leve isso em consideração ao comprar sorvete. Os preços também são acessíveis. A única reclamação que eu tenho é em relação ao tamanho da fila, mas parece que ela se move relativamente rápido e eles nunca parecem estar com falta de pessoal.
original: Just started coming here about 6 months ago, and wow I cannot believe I didn't come here sooner! I am in love with their ice cream here. Workers are always friendly. Tips are encouraged for the workers too, so keep that in mind when you get some ice cream. The prices are cheap too. My only complaint would be how long the line can get, but it seems to move relatively quickly and they never seem understaffed.

text: Tendrás una experiencia maravillosa. Gran variedad de opciones para elegir. Personal amable y atento.
original: You'll be in for a great treat. Variety of selections to choose from. Warm staff members.

text: A comida é boa. O atendimento é descortês, pois o proprietário não pede ao "chef" para interagir de forma amigável com os clientes, a menos que ele queira ou tenha tempo para isso. Ele afirma que o trabalho do "chef" em um restaurante tradicional é preparar comida de qualidade. Atitude horrível e não voltarei lá.
original: Food is good. Service is unfriendly because the owner doesn't ask the "chef" to nicely interact with customers unless he feels like it or has time to do so. He says the "chef's" job in a traditional restaurant is to make quality food. Horrible attitude and won't go back there.

text: Over 300 reviews and still 5 out of 5 had me curious and this place did not disappoint! Super good! Love it!

I have been wanting to try Milk Bar for so long because I heard great things about it. Finally got the chance to try it and I am sadly not in love with it as I want to be. First the service was not the best and the person ringing us up seemed annoyed. I got the birthday cake soft serve and I thought it was okay. Flavor of birthday cake was there but it was overly sweet for me. Also without toppings it was already $6.50. I get that we are on the strip so prices tend be higher. My husband got the chocolate cake milkshake that had cake chunks in it. He enjoyed it. I plan to give this place another chance for a better experience and try something different. It's definitely worth a try if you're in the area.

Não sei se foi por termos ido mais tarde no dia, mas os donuts estavam um pouco secos. Comprei um para levar para casa, para o meu marido, que parece ter gostado. Com certeza, vou experimentar novamente na próxima vez que passar por lá.
original: I do not know if it was because we went later during the day but the donuts were a bit dry. I bought one home for my husband who seemed to have enjoyed it. I will definitely give it another try the next time I stop by.

text: I'm giving this 5 stars but the person who paid for me may give it less...the ice cream, cookie, marsh mallow combo is absolutely genius. Slightly expensive but honestly it's pretty unique and innovative so it's worth the extra few bucks.
Café vietnamita e sorvete de amendoim com meia-camada de biscoito de chocolate. Muito cremoso e saboroso. Gostei muito.
original: Vietnamese coffee and peanut butter ice cream with half chocolate chip cookie. Very creamy and tasty. Liked it a lot

text: Weight watchers beware, this place is simply full of sweets and fattening ice cream sandwiches! You have to admit though that it's a good idea to Treat Yo'self every once in awhile. For those occasions where only delicious desserts will satisfy, I couldn't recommend Ninety's enough! If you're familiar with the boardwalk in the university area then you probably already know where it's at. Park on the side closest to the Light Rail and look for the Chinese restaurant, it's across the walk from there. While there's not much to talk of concerning the decor, it is very clean and there's a bit of seating for people looking to beat the heat. It seems that they're banking on most enjoying their treats on the boardwalk, the rest of the building quickly fills up with excited families and individuals alike wanting a delicious snack. So as far as the treats, what tickles your fancy? They have macaron ice cream sandwiches, ice cream filled doughnuts, ice cream cake pops, all kinds of desserts. You can also get your ice cream in a cup or cone, but why would you? The couple of macaron ice cream sandwiches I've gotten here were outstanding and well thought out. They offer different flavors of macarons paired with specific ice creams and toppings. The team even seems to have a thing for cereals, and incorporates them into a lot of their products! I have to admit, I didn't expect the macarons themselves to be such a high quality product since they're being used in ice cream sandwiches, but I'd say these were excellent macarons. They could even stand on their own with a traditional filling if they chose to do so. Maybe something to consider! I'd love give 'em the perfect score, but last time they were out of a LOT of the specials. They were very accommodating with substitutes, for example they were out of the samoa macaron and just did a regular vanilla on my sandwich. My girlfriend also wanted the coffee ice cream sandwich and they were out of its 'biscotti' macaron so she had to settle for a substitute as well. All in all it they were out of 3 macarons, and 2 ice creams. So I hope that next time I'm able to try some of their named creations as they intended. Still, a very good package either way. Not a gimmick, and still going strong. Way to rock, Ninety's!

Os biscoitos são gostosos e têm um sabor parecido com o de "Rice Krispies". Cada biscoito custa $4, e eles não são muito grandes. Meu favorito é o "chocolate truffle", que é delicioso por dentro, com um sabor de chocolate intenso, e a cobertura externa também é muito boa, mas não sei o que é. É simplesmente delicioso. A torta de "crack" é pequena, cara e tem um sabor razoável. O sorvete de "crack" também é bom. Não precisa de acompanhamentos. Tive dificuldade para decidir e ler o cardápio. As duas atendentes pareciam estar me pressionando.
original: Cookies are good and it kinda taste like rice crispy. It's $4 each for cookies and it's not even big. Chocolate truffle my favorite, chocolatey inside and the outer cover taste soo good but I don't know what it is. It just super good. Crack pie is small, pricey and tastes okay. The crack pie soft serve is good too. No need for toppings. I had a hard time deciding and reading their menu. The two ladies was like rushing me.

text: É MUITO PEQUENO! – Eu não esperava que fosse tão pequeno, mas a equipe é realmente ótima! Muito limpo e os milkshakes são deliciosos.
original: It's REALLY SMALL! --I didn't expect it to be so small but otherwise LOVELY STAFF! Really clean and yummy shakes

text: Excellent spot for cupcakes, cookies and ice cream. Reasonable prices and everything is very tasty. Good gluten free choices as well. I very much enjoyed this gem.

After hitting Grapes on Shea and Scottsdale for happy hour today- review coming shortly (maybe... hey, I've 12 other reviews that need to be written!), I headed to Sweet Republic for a sweet ending. I'd received a newsletter from SR that there were new flavors in honor of Valentine's Day, and I thought what a great reason to pay SR another visit! Of the two Valentine specials, Raspberry White Chocolate and White Roses, I could only sample the latter, as the former contained an allergen. I'm a sucker for floral-scented food and drink, and this SR delight was a winner! I could definitely taste roses, and the sweet cream wasn't too sweet. Loved it! I also sampled Desert Honey (a tart yogurt sweetened w/ local AZ wild desert honey), Almond Buttercrunch, Salted Butter Caramel, Cheese Course Duo, Espresso, and Mango Lassi. I took a pint of White Roses and Desert Honey ($7.50) and a scoop of Salted Butter Caramel to-go and a scoop of Almond Buttercrunch in a waffle cone (2 scoops $4.25 + $1 for waffle cone) to savor! I couldn't pass up a Chocolate Chip Walnut Oatmeal cookie ($3) as it looked so delicious on its cake display stand- one of the proprietors, Helen, offered to warm it up in the microwave. What a wonderful suggestion! I asked if she could tear off a section and warm it up... The warmed bite I took at the store was amazingly good! (I did notice that the rest of the soft-batch cookie, sampled in the car, was definitely saltier than I'd wish for in a cookie. Why didn't I detect this saltiness in the warmed-up section? Perhaps the sweetness of the almond buttercrunch made my tastebuds more sensitive to salt? Hmm...) I really enjoyed the almond buttercrunch and the cone, so much so that I wished I'd skipped on the salted butter caramel- heresy some fans of this flavor might think, but what can I say? I loved extra textural component, and the buttery toffee-sweet crunch, that the almonds provided. I may be back, maybe as soon as tomorrow!, to re-visit the espresso and the mango lassi (and grab a few more of those chocolate chip walnut cookies!). ;) p.s. Couldn't resist and just had to taste a couple scoopfuls of desert honey and white roses before placing the pint in the freezer... Oh. My. God! Run to SR before Valentine's Day is over and White Roses disappear from the rotation! (Just remember to bring your credit card- a visit could get expensive!)

Pensei que, devido às altas avaliações, este seria um ótimo lugar para comer sorvete. Após analisar o extenso cardápio, decidi experimentar um "brownie hurricane". Não havia ninguém na fila, mas pareceu demorar um pouco para preparar. O que recebi foi um copo de sorvete derretido, com alguns biscoitos de chocolate. Estava muito desagradável, já tinha batidos de sorvete mais consistentes. Além disso, custou US$ 5 por esse sorvete derretido. Acho que nunca voltarei.
original: I thought by all of the high star ratings that this place has, that this was going to be a great ice cream place. After reviewing the extensive menu, I decided to try a brownie hurricane. There was not anyone else waiting, and it seemed to take a while to prepare. What I received was a cup of melted ice cream with some brownies in it. It was very unappealing, I've had milkshakes thicker than this. On top of that it $5 for this melted ice cream, don't think I'll ever be going back.

text: The shape of ice cream was pretty and the Thai flavor was good. Selected blueberry as topping, and it was fresh and tastes great with the ice cream. However, I waited for 20 minutes to get this which was far longer than I expected.

La primera vez que fui allí, fue realmente increíble. Es un lugar muy agradable. Tenían una gran variedad de donuts para elegir. El donut que compré se llamaba "The Homer", como el personaje de "Los Simpson". Un donut clásico, con glaseado rosa y chispas. ¡Ese donut era literalmente más grande que mi cara! Era muy dulce y delicioso. ¡Definitivamente, cómprate un café o leche para acompañarlo! Donut Bar es muy popular. Por lo tanto, la principal desventaja es que no hay muchos asientos en el interior, aunque sí hay algunos afuera, a la sombra. ¡Es Las Vegas, incluso a la sombra la temperatura es de alrededor de 34°C! ¡Recomiendo totalmente que visites Donut Bar en el centro de Las Vegas!
original: The first time ever going there it was pretty awesome. It's a pretty cool They had a lot of donuts to pick from. The donut I got was called "The Homer", yes like Homer Simpson. Classic donut, pink frosting, and sprinkles. That donut was literally bigger than my face, it was very sweet, and delicious. Totally grab a coffee or milk to go with it! Donut Bar is pretty popular. So the biggest downside is that there's not that many seats inside, they do have a few seat outside in the shade. It's Las Vegas, even in the shade it's like 102° outside. I would totally recommend someone to go to the Donut Bar in Downtown Las Vegas!

text: You owe it to yourself to get a treat from this stand. Super cool location under the bridge, bring cash and your sweet tooth as they have a lot of options!

O serviço é péssimo. Eu trabalho na área e costumo parar por lá ocasionalmente. A comida é razoável para um lanche rápido, mas não é excepcional. Hoje, eu queria comer algo antes de uma reunião. Havia 5 pessoas à minha frente, e apenas uma pessoa estava atendendo os pedidos. As outras duas pessoas estavam olhando para um caixa perto da padaria. Outro funcionário estava reabastecendo bebidas e outros trabalhavam nos fundos, mas ninguém se ofereceu para ajudar a agilizar o atendimento. Mais cinco pessoas chegaram nos próximos dez minutos, e ainda assim, apenas uma pessoa estava atendendo os pedidos. Demorou mais de 30 minutos para finalmente ser atendido. Não vale a pena! Foi frustrante ver os funcionários simplesmente ignorando o fato de que havia uma fila enorme e apenas uma pessoa atendendo os clientes.
original: The service is terrible. I work in the area and have stopped in every so often. The food is decent for a quick bite, not amazing. Tonight I wanted to grab a bite to eat before a meeting. There were 5 people ahead of me with one person actually taking orders. Two other workers were looking at a register down by the bakery. Another worker stocking beverages and people working in the back, but none stepped in to help orders go faster. Five more people came in over the next ten minutes and still just one person taking orders. It took over 30 minutes to finally get called. Not worth it! It was infuriating to see the workers just ignore the fact that there was a huge line and only one person getting customers food.

text: Friendly staff, lots of different options on the menu, and it's located in the Linq area. They are really busy but the tables and floors could use some cleaning. Delicious ice cream.

Paramos para comprar alguns sorvetes, pois estávamos céticos em relação às avaliações negativas dos sorveterias espalhadas pelas lojas ao redor do Grand Canal. Este lugar é um sonho para as crianças, pois é um lugar cheio de brinquedos coloridos, doces e sorvetes por todos os lados. E o sorvete era incrível! Pegamos um pote de baunilha e um de morango vegano, que, na verdade, estava muito bom. Sem dúvida, um sorvete de excelente qualidade.
original: Stopped by for some ice cream because I was skeptical of the poor reviews of the gelato places scattered around the Grand Canal shoppes. This place is a kids dream come true because it's just so much fun colorful toys, and candy and ice cream everywhere. And the ice cream was amazing! We grabbed a scoop of vanilla and the vegan strawberry, which was actually really good. Solid ice cream for sure.

text: Always delicious. They have lots of great seasonal flavors (like espresso!) and the the cold fudge sundae is a classic.

Panadería y cafetería parisina las 24 horas - ¡quién lo habría imaginado! Fácil acceso a Amélie, con un amplio aparcamiento y muchos asientos dentro de la cafetería. Simplemente pedí un croissant de chocolate doble y una tarta de chocolate. Los productos horneados no me convencieron demasiado. Hay un menú más amplio para sándwiches, ensaladas y bebidas, que no probé. El ambiente es encantador y muy bonito. Candelabros laterales y obras de arte con temática parisina, al estilo de "Alicia en el País de las Maravillas". ¡Un lugar divertido para pasar el día o la noche!
original: Parisian 24 hour bakery and cafe - who woulda thunk?! Easy access to Amelie's with a giant parking and plenty of seating inside the cafe. I simply got a double baked chocolate croissant and chocolate tart. The baked goods were just okay for me. There is a larger menu for sandwiches and salads and drinks which I didn't partake in. The atmosphere is whimsical and super cute. Sideway chandeliers, Paris themed art work decorated a la Alice in Wonderland. Fun place to spend some time in day or night!

text: Então, parei para comprar donuts para o trabalho... foi uma experiência incrível! Tantas opções! E só para dizer que todos os tipos de donuts eram deliciosos! Apenas olhar para todas as opções e decidir qual escolher foi muito difícil... comprei 12 donuts... os funcionários foram muito prestativos, explicando os diferentes tipos... e o lugar estava lotado! Acreditam que o "crime brûlée" é o produto mais vendido, então comprei um! Estava delicioso, mas bem doce. Também comprei um "maple bar" com bacon, que estava delicioso... como alguém poderia errar com essa combinação? Recomendo muito este lugar, mas vá antes que os donuts do dia acabem!
original: So I stopped by to pick up donuts for work....it was very overwhelming! So many choices! And just let me say that every donut of any and every type was mouthwatering! Just looking at all the choices and making a decision was completely difficult....I got 12 donuts....the counter people were very helpful explaining the donuts...plus it was completely packed! The crime brÃ»lÃ©e's was allegedly their number one seller, so I got one of those! It was delicious but very sweet. I also got a maple bar with bacon very delicious...how could you go wrong with that combo anyway?! I highly recommend this place but get there before the days donuts are sold out!!

text: This place has some amazing pastries! The seating areas is decent and it's easy to find since it's on the main strip of Little Italy. The cannoli and lobster tails are really good and worth getting. The cookies are also authentic Italian cookies! The parking isn't great though. A lot of the street parking is very narrow there's a bunch of construction in the area. There was somewhat of a wait since it seemed they were understaffed and the employees seemed flustered. They have an old ticket system that you have to grab a number in the front.

Me encantan muchísimo sus macarons y otros dulces pequeños, pero no me convencieron mucho los pequeños pasteles que compré para el cumpleaños de mi marido. Estaban secos y un poco insípidos, aunque no eran terribles, definitivamente no estaban al mismo nivel que sus otros productos.
original: I absolutely love their macaroons and other small sweets, but I wasn't very impressed with the small cakes I bought for my husband's birthday. They were dry and a little bland, while not terrible definitely not on the same level as their other options.

text: Visitei a 85C Bakery em San Diego em 2017, e um dos funcionários me informou que uma unidade LV estava em andamento. Dois anos depois, finalmente chegou! Esperei alguns dias após a inauguração para visitar, e era evidente que alguns aspectos precisavam de melhorias. Era 13h e a maioria das prateleiras estava vazia. Eles gritavam "PÃO FRESCO", mas estavam produzindo apenas 3 tipos diferentes: BerryTale, Choco Bun e tortas de ovo. No final, peguei algumas, simplesmente porque não havia muitas opções. A fila para o caixa demorou cerca de 30 minutos. Era segunda-feira e havia bebidas com sal marinho à promoção no aplicativo, mas quando fui pedir e perguntei ao caixa se era à promoção, ela disse que não faz promoções, pois é uma loja nova. Voltei uma segunda vez, desta vez, às 9h da manhã. As filas estavam melhores, a variedade era grande (não apenas caixas de BerryTale), e o "PÃO FRESCO" que estava saindo era de melhor qualidade. No final, comprei duas bandejas, pois não queria perder a oportunidade de experimentar tudo. Perguntei ao caixa se ainda não faziam promoções, pois queria aproveitar a oferta de "comprar um vale-presente de 20 dólares e ganhar uma caneca grátis", mas na última vez que visitei, disseram que não estavam fazendo. Ela me olhou com uma expressão confusa e disse que deveriam ter me informado sobre a promoção, e pediu desculpas pela informação incorreta. No final, jantei no Shanghai Plaza e observei a variedade, e vi que ainda tinham alguns itens premium (consegui ver alguém pegando um pão rosa, que devia ser o de chocolate com morango). Ainda havia uma fila do lado de fora, mas pelo menos pude ver que as prateleiras ainda estavam cheias de doces. Tenho grandes expectativas para a 85C e acho que ainda estão aperfeiçoando o serviço, pois todos estão vindo visitar e esperar nas filas. *Dica: há um quiosque na frente para pedir bebidas e bolos apenas! Uma garota atrás de mim não pegou uma bandeja e disse que só queria uma bebida. Uma das senhoras ao lado disse: "Você vai ter que esperar nessa fila por uma bebida?!" Avisei sobre o quiosque e ela foi e voltou rapidamente.
original: I went to the 85C Bakery in SD in 2017 and one of the workers told me that a LV location was in the works. Two years later, it's FINALLY HERE! I waited a couple days after the grand opening to visit and you could tell that some things needed improvement. It was 1pm and most of the shelves were empty. They would yell, "FRESH BREAD," but they were only cranking out 3 different kind - BerryTale, Choco Bun, and Egg Tarts. Ended up grabbing a few, just because there wasn't much to choose from. The line was about a 30 minute wait to get to the register. It was Monday and the had BOGO sea salt drinks advertised on their app, but when I go to order and ask the cashier if it's BOGO she says that they don't do promotions since they're a new store. I came a second time, this time, at 9am. The lines are better, the selection was plentiful (not just cases of BerryTale), and the FRESH BREAD that was coming out was more of the good stuff. Ended up with 2 trays full because I didn't want to pass up trying everything. I asked the cashier if they're still not doing promotions because I wanted to do the "buy a $20 gift card and get a free mug" deal, but the last time I visited they said they weren't doing it. She gave me a confused look and said they should've wrong me up for the promotion and apologized for the misinformation. I ended up eating dinner at Shanghai Plaza and took a peek at the selection and saw they still had some premium items (I could see someone picking up a pink bun which had to be the Strawberry Chocolate one). There was still a line outside, but at least I could see the shelves were still full of pastries. I have high hopes for 85C and think they're still working out the kinks because everyone and their mamas are coming to visit and wait out the lines. *Pro-tip: there's a kiosk in front to order drinks and cakes only! A girl behind me didn't grab a tray and said she only wanted a drink. One of the ladies next to me said, "you're going to wait in this line for a drink?!" I let her know about the kiosk and she was in and out quickly.

text: Mi heladería favorita de todos los tiempos. Está a solo 5 minutos en coche de mi casa y vengo aquí desde que era niño. Mi familia y yo venimos casi todas las semanas. Su helado es muy cremoso y no demasiado dulce. Casi siempre pido el de plátano, es único. El resto del tiempo, pruebo sus sabores de temporada, mis favoritos son el de plátano con mantequilla de cacahuete (¡sorpresa!), el de las tres bayas, el de tarta de limón y el de calabaza con caramelo y galletas de jengibre en otoño. Además, su helado de flor de naranja es perfecto para el verano, tiene un sabor similar al de un creamsicle y nunca lo he visto en otro lugar. A mi madre le encanta el sundae de frambuesa roja. Tienen sucursales por todo el área de Cleveland, pero he crecido viniendo a esta.
original: My favorite ice cream shop of all time. It's a quick 5 minute drive from my house and I've been coming here since I was a kid. My family and I come pretty much every week. Their ice cream is so creamy and not overly sugary. I get the banana ice cream 98% of the time, It's unlike any other. The other 2% of the time I get their seasonal flavors my favorite are banana peanut butter (shocker), triple berry, lemon meringue pie, and pumpkin caramel ginger snap in the fall! Also their orange blossom is perfect for the summertime it tastes like a light creamsicle and I've never seen this flavor anywhere else. My mom loves the red raspberry sundae. The have locations all over the Cleveland area but I've grown up coming to this one.

text: Quintinha charmosa. Seleção limitada de pratos e sorvete de qualidade mediana. É bom que o local esteja aberto até tarde.
original: Cute patio. Limited selection of menu and mediocre ice cream. Nice that this place is open late.

text: Visite Sweet Republic esta semana y diga: "Apoyo a 'Bake for Hope'", y ellos donarán una parte de sus ganancias a esta organización. "Bake for Hope" es una organización benéfica que busca concienciar sobre el cáncer de mama y destinar las ganancias de las ventas de pasteles a nivel nacional a las oficinas locales de Susan G. Komen for the Cure. Este sábado, "Bake for Hope" estará allí para vender nuestros deliciosos cupcakes, brownies y galletas caseras. ¡Es la combinación PERFECTA: pastel y helado!
original: Go to Sweet Republic this week and say, "I support Bake for Hope," and they will donate a portion of their proceeds to Bake for Hope. Bake for Hope is a charity that is raising breast cancer awareness and providing proceeds of nationwide bake sales to local Susan G Komen for the Cure affiliate offices. On this Saturday, Bake for Hope will be there to sell our delicious homemade cupcakes, brownies, and cookies. It is the PERFECT pairing- cake and ice cream!

text: Milk Bar no fue tan bueno como esperaba. Me perdí la ubicación en Nueva York y estaba deseando probarlo aquí en Las Vegas. Al no saber qué pedir, decidí probar el "Greatest Hits" (19 dólares), que incluía: una porción de tarta de nuez, helado de leche de cereal, bombones de cumpleaños (3) y una galleta de avena. También compré la galleta de maíz y la galleta de chocolate con chispas de maíz. Mi menos favorita fue el helado de leche de cereal con trozos. Realmente no tenía mucho sabor y era pequeña. La tarta de nuez también era pequeña. ¡Una estafa! La tarta de nuez estaba bien, pero no era espectacular. Los bombones de cumpleaños tenían una textura extraña, como si estuvieran demasiado blandos, poco cocidos o con demasiado harina. No fue muy agradable. De verdad quería probar el pastel de cumpleaños, pero no lo venden por porciones, solo entero (56 dólares). ¡Pero sí me gustaron las galletas! Probablemente las volvería a comprar, pero me gustaron más las galletas de maíz. Una gran desventaja es que no hay asientos ni mesas altas para disfrutar de los postres. Sin embargo, el servicio al cliente fue excelente. Si alguna vez estoy en la zona y quiero gastar dinero, podría volver por estas golosinas sobrevaloradas.
original: Milk Bar wasn't as good as I thought it would be. I missed out on the NYC location and was looking forward to trying it here in Vegas. Not knowing what to try, I settled on the "Greatest Hits" ($19), which came with: slice of crack pie, cereal milk soft serve, bday truffles (3), and a compost cookie. I also purchased the corn cookie and the corn flake chocolate chip marshmallow cookie. My least favorite was the cereal milk soft serve with crunch. It didn't really taste like much and was small! The crack pie was also small. What a rip off. The crack pie was good, not amazing. Bday truffles had a strange mouth feel, like too doughy, undercooked, or flour-y. It wasn't that enjoyable. I really wanted to try the birthday cake, but they don't sell it by the slice, only whole ($56). I did like the cookies! I would try them all again, but I liked the corn cookie the best! One big flaw they have is no where to sit or even high top tables to enjoy your treats. Customer service was excellent though. If I am ever in the area and want to throw away some money, I might be back for these overpriced goodies.

text: ¡Me encanta LOVE page! Vengo aquí desde que era niño, y la calidad sigue siendo la misma: helados, batidos, etc., ¡e incluso las hamburguesas, perritos y papas fritas son aún mejores! Los precios son tan bajos que casi es increíble. Si estás en el sur de la ciudad y buscas helados de calidad, este es el lugar. Y créeme, vale la pena esperar en la fila, ¡siempre lo ha sido!
original: LOVE page's, been coming here since i was a kid, same GREAT ice cream, shakes, etc, even BETTER burgers, dogs & fries, prices so low it's almost shocking, if you're in the south hills & want QUALITY soft serve this is the place, & believe me, it's worth the wait when the line is long, always has been

text: ¡Vaya! Hay muchos lugares que dicen ser los mejores, pero este es realmente excelente. Sloan's es delicioso. Pedimos la opción de degustación, que incluye 9 porciones de helado. Por cierto, las porciones son pequeñas... y me gustaría que no estuvieran todas en el mismo recipiente. Sería ideal tener un recipiente tipo caja de huevos. Sin embargo, el helado es delicioso. También pedí un brownie, porque me encantan los brownies. Soy muy exigente, y este fue uno de los mejores que he probado. En mi opinión, es un poco caro, pero al menos vale la pena.
original: Oh wow... A lot of places claim to be the best...but this is legit. Sloan's is so delicious! We got the luxury sampler which gets you 9 scoops of ice cream. FYI the scoops are small...and I wish they weren't all in the same container. It would be nice to have like an egg carton type container. However, the ice cream is delicious! I also got a brownie because brownies are my favorite. I am very picky and this was one of the best I've ever had. In my opinion it's expensive, but at least its worth it!

text: Vale... afuera hace mucho frío. Estoy usando un abrigo abrigado y la fila se extiende hasta el estacionamiento... Creo que esto lo dice todo. Simplemente lo mejor. Nada supera la experiencia de pasar un momento difícil en casa disfrutando de un delicioso helado de Handel. Muy recomendable.
original: Ok.. it is getting very cold outside. I am wearing a heavy jacket and the queue extends into the parking lot... I think this says it all. Simply the best. Nothing gets you through a tough time of staying at home as a rewarding bucket of Handel's ice cream. More than recommended.

text: Eu comprei o bolo de aniversário e os pequenos bolinhos de aniversário, e ambos ficaram apenas "ok". Estavam bons, mas não eram excepcionais, considerando o preço de 14 dólares por fatia. Era o meu aniversário quando comprei, e recebi os bolinhos de presente, mas, para ser sincero, não me agradaram muito. Talvez na próxima, mas essa fatia no meu dia especial não foi tão boa.
original: I had the birthday cake and birthday cake balls and both were just meh. It was okay but not amazing for a $14 slice of cake. It was my birthday when I bought it and was kindly given the cake balls but i wasn't a fan honestly. Maybe next time but that slice on my big day didn't make the cut.

text: Este lugar es una cuestión de suerte. Mi favorito son las galletas de copos de maíz y la tarta de nueces. Todo lo demás, ya sea demasiado salado o demasiado dulce.
original: This place is a hit or miss. My favorite is the cornflake cookies and crack pie. Everything else is either too salty or overwhelmingly sweet.

text: A pior experiência em uma filial da Ghirardelli! Enquanto esperava pelo meu pedido, vimos baratas rastejando sob as mesas e nas paredes. Eu discretamente mencionei isso a um dos funcionários, pois já havia visto outras pessoas entrarem em pânico ao ver uma barata, e queria evitar que isso acontecesse com os outros. Ele contou para todos os colegas e eles começaram a rir. Depois, ele foi matá-la e me zombou, dizendo: "Nossa, tem baratas, como se elas fossem machucar alguém". Eu não consegui terminar o sorvete, estava muito incomodado com o atendimento.
original: Worst experience at a Ghirardelli ever! As I was waiting for my order we seen some roaches crawling under the tables and on the walls. I quietly mentioned it to one of the workers because I have seen other people explode in a store after seeing a roach and was trying to avoid that for them. He told every co worker there and they all started laughing. After he went to kill it he walked away and mocked me saying "OMG there's roaches, as if they're gonna hurt anybody" Did not even finish the ice cream I was disgusted by the service.

text: ¡El helado más delicioso que he probado! Es tan bueno que me encanta comerlo con un cono de waffle. Este lugar es increíble, ¡y tienes que probarlo!
original: The best ice cream I've ever tried! So good, I love it with the waffle cone.. this place is just amazing and you have to try

text: Essas não são as melhores rosquinhas, mas também não são ruins. Já experimentei as rosquinhas deles em três ocasiões diferentes, e em todas, a experiência foi decepcionante. "Rosquinhas secas" é uma descrição que se encaixa bem.
original: These aren't awful donuts, but they certainly aren't the best. I've tried their donuts on three different occasions, and each time was a lackluster experience. Dry donuts describes it best.

text: O local é em uma área tranquila, mas o sorvete não era muito bom. Era aceitável, mas nada de especial. O sabor era fraco. O caramelo salgado tinha muito sal. Talvez tenha sido um lote defeituoso. Provavelmente não voltaria.
original: The place is in a cool little area but the ice cream wasn't that great. It was okay but nothing special. It was tasteless. The salted caramel had way too much salt. This just could have been a bad batch. Probably wouldn't go back.

text: Não havia lugar para sentar e desfrutar do sundae de 23 dólares que compramos. Muito charmoso e divertido. Experimente se tiver a oportunidade. O atendimento é excelente, mas perdi duas estrelas por falta de lugares para sentar.
original: No place to sit and enjoy the $23 sundae we bought. Super cute and fun. Get a scoop if you get a chance. Service is great, lost 2 stars due to no seating

text: ¡Increíble! Desde marcos de fotos hasta elementos decorativos de estilo francés que llegan hasta el techo, un ambiente impresionante... Y no olvidemos el ambiente. Definitivamente un lugar al que acudir cuando se tiene antojo de algo delicioso. Sin importar la hora o la ocasión. Los precios pueden ser un poco elevados, pero la experiencia en sí misma lo vale. Además, ¡los brownies con caramelo salado son los mejores! Me encanta Amelie's, ¡definitivamente volveré!
original: Wow! From picture frames, to ceiling high french props, amazing scenery... Not to mention the atmosphere. Definitely a must come to when craving some treats! No matter the time or occasion. The prices may be a tad high, but just the experience is worth it. Not to mention the best caramel salted brownie treats! Love Amelie's, def coming back!

text: Esta é a nossa primeira vez aqui. Se não fosse pela cor rosa vibrante e o clima agradável, provavelmente teríamos simplesmente passado. Eles oferecem uma variedade de bebidas, desde água até opções com frutas e CBD. Além disso, têm espressos e muitos sabores de sorvete. Também têm diversos itens, como balas de cigarro, que eu adorava quando criança. A equipe foi simpática e o sorvete estava excelente. Pena que eu não posso comer sorvete de verdade. Minha filha comeu o sorvete de verdade.
original: This is our first time here. If it wasn't for the hot pink and the weather being nice outside, we may have just kept walking. They have a handful of drinks from water to fruity to CBD drinks. Along with espressos, and lots of ice cream available. They have an assortment of different items like cigarette candy, loved that stuff as a kid. The staff was friendly and the ice cream was terrific. Too bad I can't have real ice cream. My daughter had the real ice cream.

text: Casi siempre tengo que parar aquí para comprar helado cuando estoy en Ohio City. La única vez que no lo hago es cuando estoy en una dieta, jaja. De todas formas, fui la semana pasada y siempre me impresiona su excelente servicio. Me permiten probar todos los sabores que quiera y no se quejen. Me encanta la estructura de cristal y cómo se puede subir a otra planta para ver cómo preparan su producto. ¡Es muy interesante! Normalmente no presto atención a las opciones de sorbete o helado vegano, ya que suelo optar por el helado cremoso. Pero mi amigo quería comprar helado vegano para llevar, y resulta que tenían dos opciones: uno de chocolate y otro de caramelo salado. Compró uno de cada sabor y ¡incluso vendían conos veganos!
original: I almost always have to stop and get ice cream here when I'm in Ohio city! The only time I don't is when I'm on a diet lol! Anyways I visited this past week and I am always amazed at their attentive service. They allow you to try as many flavors as you want and don't get upset. I love the glass walls and how you can go upstairs and watch how they make their product! Very cool! Usually I don't pay attention to sorbets or vegan ice cream options because I usually go for the creamy ice cream - I have no restrictions when it comes to ice cream. But my friend wanted to stop in to get vegan ice cream togo and what do you know.. they had 2 vegan options chocolate and a salty caramel. He bought 1 of each pint and they even sold Vegan cones!

text: Advertencia: Esta reseña de cinco estrellas se basa en una nostalgia extrema. Cuando era pequeño, insistía en que íbamos aquí después de cada visita al zoológico. Ahora que ya puedo conducir, me sorprende que no vaya aquí con más frecuencia. Honey Hut es el helado más consistentemente delicioso de Cleveland. Para algunos, puede parecer una opinión controvertida, pero yo la defiendo. Nunca he ido aquí y no me haya complacido con el sabor, el precio y el ambiente acogedor de este pequeño puesto. Esta vez, probé el sabor especial: banana con chispas de chocolate. Era lo suficientemente "de banana" y tenía un sabor increíblemente fresco. Mi madre eligió el sabor clásico de miel y nueces. Este sabor siempre es un éxito en mi opinión. Aunque es muy dulce, las nueces equilibran el sabor y te hacen disfrutarlo con calma, en lugar de consumirlo en dos segundos. Mi hermana probó el helado de chocolate y mantequilla de cacahuete. Aunque no soy fan del helado de chocolate, ella se fue con una sonrisa en la cara.
original: Warning: This five-star review is bolstered by extreme nostalgia. Little me asked, no, demanded that we went here after every zoo trip. Now that not-as-little me can drive, I'm shocked that I don't go here more. Honey Hut is the most consistently delicious ice cream in Cleveland. A hot take for some, but I stand by it. Not once have I gone here and not been pleased with the flavor I picked, the price, and welcoming atmosphere of this little stand. This time around, I got the featured flavor - banana chocolate chip. Just banana-y enough and tasted impressively fresh. My mom went for the classic honey pecan flavor. This flavor is always a winner in my book. While it is incredibly sweet, the nut pieces balance it out and make you take your time rather than consuming it in two seconds flat. My sister got chocolate peanut butter. While I'm not a chocolate-based ice cream fan, she still left with a smile on her face.

text: The gluten free birthday cake truffles are ridiculous. Stopped by to pick some up, and was able to grab a few 3 packs. Service was fast and friendly. The cake bites are honestly perfect. They're soft and cake-y without being crumbly or having that "gluten-free" taste. No mealy, pasty texture. They're perfect, and it was too easy to get them.
Amazing! Best deserts and pastries I've ever tried. Have to go back before I leave Vegas.

Great flavors but I'm docking a star for portion size. I've eaten at other locations and the portions are significantly larger. These were notably small and one of our orders was given to the wrong person and we got hassled about it. They ultimately remade it but we thought for a moment that they were going to try and charge us to remake it. If the flavors hadn't been so strong, I would have given one or two less stars for the overall experience.

Si estás cerca del West Side Market, una parada en Campbell's Sweets es imprescindible. Quizás no sea imprescindible, pero si te gustan los dulces deliciosos, definitivamente vale la pena detenerse. Tienen palomitas de maíz en todos los sabores (el estilo es similar al de una mezcla de Chicago), chocolates y, quizás, mi favorito... cupcakes. Durante este confinamiento, ofrecen pedidos con anticipación que se pueden realizar durante toda la semana y recoger los viernes por la tarde. Exactamente lo que necesitas para pasar el fin de semana. No olvides consultar su cuenta de Instagram cada semana. La disponibilidad de los productos cambia semanalmente. Simplemente te acercas, llamas y ofrecen entrega sin contacto en tu coche.
original: If you're around the West Side Market, a stop to Campbell's Sweets is a necessity. Maybe not a necessity, but if you like delicious treats, it's definitely worth your time to stop in. They have popcorn in all types of flavors (dichotomy is similar to a Chicago mix style), chocolates, and perhaps my favorite... cupcakes. During this quarantine, they have call ahead orders that can be placed through the week and picked up on Friday afternoons. Exactly what you need to get you through the weekend. Be sure to check out their instagram account each week. The items available changes weekly. You simply pull up, call, and they have contact free delivery at your car.

text: This place is so cute!!! The ice creams are super flavorful and it's very hard to stop at one. I wished I could try them all! Not to mention the great decor around the place. Definitely ready for some great foodie pictures. We went when the place was close to closing time. Whereas most staff but get frustrated with late customers, the staff here was ready to help!

Rule: if there is no line, go and grab ice cream! This was the original Jeni's location in Charlotte and still super popular. The staff are super friendly, masked-up and ready to go. The stand alone building only has counter seating and the line moves through pretty fast. Lots of outdoor tables to sit at or the large concrete steps behind the store. I really only went in here to get a few pints to take home, so I'm not sure how they are handling samples during Covid, but they always gave you separate sampling spoons and the the staff always wore gloves before the pandemic. Southend is pretty lucky to have a cool spot like Jeni's to enjoy after going to one of the many restaurants nearby.
Best ice cream in Vegas! A variety of flavors and different presentations. The kids that work there are great!

Entramos después de ver los malvaviscos tostados que tenían en sus helados de s'mores. Cuando entramos, no había nadie, lo cual fue perfecto porque quería probar los diferentes sabores. La chica detrás del mostrador fue muy amable y nos permitió probar los sabores que queríamos.
